paper.title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
paper.abstract: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable. Framing the token layer as source coding -- transformer compute is monotone in sequence length, whose per-atom floor is the Shannon rate $H/\log_2 V$, an object already applied to tokenizers in prior work -- we assemble a token-cost ledger that splits each language'

summary.core_problem: 量化多语言 tokenizer 对非英语文本造成的 token 成本，并区分哪些成本可由更合适的编码消除，哪些属于不可消除的语言或模态因素。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer 与多语言预训练数据成本分析。它把“非英语 token tax”拆成可移除编码冗余、残余编码 slack、内在内容项和与多模态相关的 grapheme-to-phoneme 项，为多语言词表设计和训练算力预算提供了更细的成本账本。
summary.technical_approach: 论文将 tokenization 视为源编码问题，用 Shannon rate H/log2 V 作为给定词表大小下的理论下界，并在固定平行语义内容上比较不同语言的 token 成本。它构建 token-cost ledger，将生产 tokenizer 的开销拆分为可由 script-matched code 移除的部分、仍残留的编码 slack、内容本身差异，以及与文本成本正交但影响语音/多模态成本的 grapheme-to-phoneme 项。
summary.experiments: 实验在 FLORES-200 的 8 种语言上进行。摘要报告生产 tokenizer 对 Indic scripts 的 token 成本最高可达英语的 8.9 倍；用 1,012 个句子训练的 script-matched code 可移除超额成本的中位数 64%，bootstrap 95% CI 为 [0.638, 0.647]。摘要未说明具体 tokenizer 名称和所有语言列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper quantifies the multilingual tokenization tax and separates the part that can be removed by better coding from the part that reflects intrinsic content or modality-specific factors.
summary_en.importance: This is a tokenizer and multilingual pretraining-data cost analysis. Its main value is a token-cost ledger that decomposes non-English overhead into removable coding redundancy, residual coding slack, intrinsic content, and a grapheme-to-phoneme term relevant to multimodal cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors frame tokenization as source coding and use the Shannon-rate floor H/log2 V as a lower bound under a fixed vocabulary size. On parallel content, they compare language-level token costs and decompose the overhead into removable redundancy via script-matched codes, remaining coding slack, intrinsic content, and an orthogonal grapheme-to-phoneme component.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses FLORES-200 across eight languages. The abstract reports that a production tokenizer can cost up to 8.9x more tokens for Indic scripts than for English, while a script-matched code trained on 1,012 sentences removes a median 64% of the excess cost, with bootstrap 95% CI [0.638, 0.647]. The abstract does not specify the production tokenizer name or the full language set.

recommendation.zh: 值得看账本分解而不是只看倍数；它会影响多语 tokenizer ablation 的归因方式。
recommendation.en: Read the ledger decomposition, not just the headline ratios; it changes how multilingual tokenizer ablations should attribute cost.

paper.title: Subword Segmental BabyLMs: Learning to Tokenise for Sample-Efficient Pretraining
paper.abstract: In the standard LM training pipeline, subword tokenisation is applied as a preprocessing step. Subword segmental language modelling is an alternative paradigm in which tokenisation is learned during training, allowing the model to discover subword units that optimise its training objective. In this paper, we present our submission to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge, for which we develop two new subword segmental LMs: SubSegGPT and SubSegDeBERTa. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenisati

summary.core_problem: 解决固定子词 tokenizer 作为预处理步骤的局限，探索在预训练过程中联合学习 tokenization，提升小数据 regime 下的样本效率。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在于把 tokenizer 从静态前处理重新拉回训练目标内部。对基座研究员来说，重点不是 BabyLM 榜单，而是“tokenizer 是否应被 jointly optimized”这个老问题在低资源设定下又有了较干净的证据。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出两个 subword segmental LM。SubSegGPT 是 decoder-only，自回归预训练时同时学习分词；SubSegDeBERTa 是 encoder-based，在 masked word 生成时联合学习 tokenization。核心思想是用 segmental language modeling 让模型自己发现最有利于训练目标的子词单元，而不是先用 BPE/Unigram 固定切分。
summary.experiments: 工作面向 2026 BabyLM Challenge 的 Strict 与 Strict-small 赛道。摘要称 Strict 赛道最佳提交是 SubSegDeBERTa，在 zero-shot 评测上有明显增益；Strict-small 最佳提交是 SubSegGPT，优于基于固定 tokenization 的 baseline。没有大规模基座训练，但在 sample-efficient pretraining 设定下信号明确。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自开普敦大学计算机系。该工作与 BabyLM 社区关注的认知启发式、小样本预训练和可学习 tokenization 方向一致。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles the limitation of treating subword tokenization as a fixed preprocessing step, and studies whether tokenization can be learned jointly during pretraining to improve sample efficiency in low-data regimes.
summary_en.importance: The value is not the BabyLM leaderboard itself, but the return of a core question for foundation-model training: should the tokenizer be jointly optimized with the LM objective rather than frozen beforehand?
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces two subword segmental LMs. SubSegGPT is a decoder-only model that learns tokenization during autoregressive pretraining. SubSegDeBERTa is an encoder-style model that jointly learns masked-word generation and tokenization. The key idea is segmental language modeling, letting the model discover subword units that best serve the training objective instead of relying on a fixed BPE/Unigram pipeline.
summary_en.experiments: The work is submitted to the 2026 BabyLM Challenge under the Strict and Strict-small tracks. The abstract reports that SubSegDeBERTa is the top Strict submission with notable zero-shot gains, while SubSegGPT is the top Strict-small submission and beats tokenization-based baselines. The setup is small-scale, but the signal is directly relevant to sample-efficient pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is from the University of Cape Town. The work aligns with BabyLM-style research on cognitively motivated, low-resource pretraining and learnable tokenization.

recommendation.zh: 如果你还把 tokenizer 当固定外部件，这篇至少会动摇这个 prior；先看模型定义和与固定分词 baseline 的对照，榜单名次反而次要。
recommendation.en: If you still treat the tokenizer as a frozen external component, this should at least weaken that prior; read the model formulation and the fixed-tokenizer ablations, not the leaderboard.

paper.title: When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision
paper.abstract: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input

summary.core_problem: 论文挑战了将 Tokenization 仅视为输入预处理的传统观点，提出在自回归模型中，输出端的 Tokenization 粒度决定了模型单次前向传播必须解决的计算量，从而直接定义了训练损失的监督单元和学习问题的难度。
summary.importance: 为理解 Tokenization 如何影响模型性能提供了一个全新的视角（输出监督视角）。这解释了为什么在算术、时间推理等任务中，不同的 Tokenization 策略会导致截然不同的性能和内部表示，对预训练数据处理和模型评估有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 通过将输入和输出 Tokenization 解耦，在数值推理（算术）任务上进行控制实验。对比了“整体 Tokenization”（如将多位数字作为一个 Token）和“碎片化 Tokenization”（如按位拆分数字）。提出了“最小计算假设”：模型只解决输出监督所要求的计算，没有直接压力去解决更多。
summary.experiments: 实验表明，任务性能、训练动态和模型内部表示主要由输出 Tokenization 决定，而对输入 Tokenization 相对不敏感。探针实验证实了“最小计算假设”，但也发现模型会部分解析损失未奖励的未来信息。对 120 篇近期数值推理论文的调查显示，近 70% 的论文在未注意 Tokenization 差异的情况下比较模型，这可能导致结论偏差。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中关于“输出监督视角”的论述，以及 Section 2 中输入输出解耦的实验设计。Section 3 关于“最小计算假设”的探针实验也很有启发性。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper challenges the conventional view of tokenization as merely input preprocessing, arguing that in autoregressive models, the granularity of output tokenization determines the computation required in a single forward pass, thereby defining the unit of supervision and the difficulty of the learning problem.
summary_en.importance: It provides a novel perspective (output supervision) to understand how tokenization affects model performance. This explains why different tokenization strategies lead to vastly different performance and internal representations in tasks like arithmetic and temporal reasoning, offering significant insights for pre-training data processing and model evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors conduct controlled experiments on numeric reasoning (arithmetic) by decoupling input and output tokenization. They compare 'holistic tokenization' (e.g., treating a multi-digit number as a single token) with 'fragmented tokenization' (e.g., splitting by digit). They propose the 'minimal computation hypothesis': models only resolve what their output supervision requires and are under no direct pressure to resolve more.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that task performance, training dynamics, and internal representations are primarily driven by output tokenization and are largely invariant to input tokenization. Probing experiments confirm the minimal computation hypothesis but also reveal that models partially resolve future information not rewarded by the loss. A survey of 120 recent papers on numeric reasoning shows that nearly 70% compare models without noting tokenization differences, potentially biasing conclusions.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the argument on the 'output supervision perspective', and Section 2 for the experimental design decoupling input and output. Section 3 on the probing experiments for the 'minimal computation hypothesis' is also highly insightful. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 视角很新颖，将 Tokenization 视为输出监督信号，对理解不同 Tokenizer 导致的模型能力差异有启发，建议阅读实验设计和结论部分。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective treating tokenization as an output supervision signal, providing insights into model capability differences caused by different tokenizers. Recommend reading the experimental design and conclusion sections.

paper.title: Toppling the Hierarchy in Byte-level Language Modeling
paper.abstract: This work examines recent byte-level models and their failure to perfectly manipulate characters. State-of-the-art byte-level models use a hierarchical structure, starting at the byte level, downsampling to the word level, and then upsampling back to bytes. While this improves training and inference efficiency, we find that the hierarchical design itself limits character-level understanding, with pure byte-level models consistently outperforming hierarchical variants on character manipulation ta

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作问的是：byte-level LM 的字符操作能力为什么仍然不稳定，瓶颈是否来自主流 hierarchical byte architecture 中“先按字节、再下采样到词级、最后回到字节”的设计。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的启发主要在 tokenizer-free / byte-level LM 的架构取舍。结论比较清楚：如果目标包含精细字符操作，纯 byte-level Transformer 仍然更可靠；hierarchical 结构带来训练和推理效率，但会削弱字节级注意力对字符关系的直接建模。这个结果提醒基座模型设计时不能只看传统知识/推理 benchmark，字符级、低资源文字、代码、格式控制等场景可能对 byte-level attention 有单独要求。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 hierarchical byte model 拆成四类模块：字符级注意力 C_a、字符级 FFN C_f、词级注意力 W_a、词级 FFN W_f。这样可以分别控制注意力和 FFN 是在完整字节序列上运行，还是只在下采样后的词级位置上运行。工作比较了纯 byte Transformer，以及 Middle、Bottom、Top、Interleaved 等多种层级放置策略。传统 BLT / Bolmo 类结构通常是少量字符层、大量词级层、再接少量字符解码层；作者额外考察把字符层放在前部、交错放置、以及只替换 attention 或 FFN 的变体。核心观察是，字符级能力主要来自 byte-level attention，而不是单纯来自 byte-level FFN。原因也比较直接：字符操作需要在原始字节位置之间建立精细对齐和复制关系，下采样后的词级 attention 会把这些关系压缩掉，后续再上采样无法完全恢复。
summary.experiments: 实验从头训练两档模型：12 层、hidden size 768、约 100M 参数，对应 1B word 训练数据；24 层、hidden size 1024、约 400M 参数，对应 4B word 训练数据。训练语料来自 Nemotron-ClimbMix 子集，规模按 Qiu et al. 的 token/parameter scaling 建议配置。评测重点是 CUTE / EXECUTE 一类字符操作任务，并与常规 benchmark 表现一起观察效率和能力的权衡。主要结果是纯 byte-level 模型在字符理解上稳定优于 hierarchical 变体；在 hierarchical 设计中，保留更多 byte-level attention 比保留 byte-level FFN 更关键。较大规模实验还用于检查字符层数量应随深度同比例增加，还是像 Bolmo 类设计那样保持固定。整体结论倾向于：如果必须使用层级结构，应优先把有限的 byte-level 计算预算分配给 attention，并谨慎选择字符层的位置，而不是简单沿用“少量字符编码层 + 大量词级层 + 少量字符解码层”的模板。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 BLT、Bolmo、CUTE/EXECUTE 结果的动机分析；再看 Methodology 的 C_a/C_f/W_a/W_f 记号，这是全文最有用的抽象。重点看 Figure 1 和列出 12 层、24 层结构的表格，它们说明作者如何把层级位置、模块类型和计算预算拆开。结果部分建议关注三类对比：纯 byte vs hierarchical；byte attention vs byte FFN；固定字符层数量 vs 随模型深度扩展。对预训练工程最有参考价值的是 attention/FFN 分解消融，因为它直接影响 tokenizer-free 模型的架构预算分配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why recent byte-level LMs still fail on precise character manipulation, and whether the main limitation comes from the common hierarchy that downsamples bytes to word-level states and later upsamples back to bytes.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining is the architecture trade-off in tokenizer-free language modeling. A pure byte-level Transformer remains the safer choice for fine-grained character operations, while hierarchical byte models buy efficiency by removing much of the direct byte-level attention. This matters for scripts with little tokenizer coverage, code, formatting-sensitive generation, and any setting where copying or editing characters is part of the capability target.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose a byte-level Transformer block into four module types: byte-level attention C_a, byte-level feed-forward C_f, word-level attention W_a, and word-level feed-forward W_f. Word-level modules operate on downsampled positions and add their updates back to the residual stream; byte-level modules process the full sequence. This notation lets them compare pure byte models with several hierarchy layouts, including Middle, Bottom, Top, and Interleaved variants. It also lets them isolate whether character manipulation depends more on attention or feed-forward computation at the byte level. The central finding is that byte-level attention is the critical component. Downsampling can reduce sequence length and cost, but it also removes direct attention paths between individual byte positions. Once those paths are gone, later upsampling layers cannot fully reconstruct the missing fine-grained alignment information.
summary_en.experiments: The study trains models from scratch at two scales: a 12-layer, width-768 model of roughly 100M parameters on a 1B-word subset of Nemotron-ClimbMix, and a 24-layer, width-1024 model of roughly 400M parameters on 4B words. The scaling choice follows a token-per-parameter rule from Qiu et al., treating GPT-2 tokens roughly as words. The evaluation focuses on character manipulation benchmarks such as CUTE and EXECUTE, while also checking the broader performance-efficiency trade-off. Pure byte-level models consistently perform best on character-level tasks. Among hierarchical variants, replacing word-level computation with byte-level attention gives more benefit than doing the same for feed-forward layers. The larger-scale runs examine whether the number of byte-level layers should stay fixed or grow with model depth, a design choice where earlier systems such as Slagle-style models and Bolmo-style models differ.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 20–30 minutes. Read the motivation in the introduction, especially the discussion of BLT, Bolmo, CUTE, and EXECUTE. Then focus on the methodology section introducing C_a, C_f, W_a, and W_f; this abstraction is the main reusable part. Figure 1 and the architecture tables for the 12-layer and 24-layer runs are worth checking carefully. In the results, prioritize three comparisons: pure byte versus hierarchy, byte-level attention versus byte-level feed-forward, and fixed versus depth-scaled byte layers. The attention/FFN ablation is the most relevant part for pretraining architecture decisions.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在考虑 byte tokenizer、latent patching 或分层压缩，这篇会直接提醒你：压缩掉的不是冗余，而可能正是字符级 attention 机制；重点看消融，不必纠结任务本身。
recommendation.en: If you care about byte tokenization, latent patching, or hierarchical compression, this paper is a useful warning: what gets compressed away may be the very byte-level attention needed for character control; read the ablations, not the task framing.

paper.title: CNeo-Bench: Diagnosing Large Language Models on Chinese Neologisms
paper.abstract: Chinese neologisms exploit diverse and unique linguistic mechanisms, such as phonetic substitution (e.g., 886 for ``bye-bye'') and visual character decomposition that are rare in other languages. We introduce CNeo-Bench, a benchmark of 4,759 such neologisms with reference definitions, organized into five top-level categories and nine subcategories by the linguistic mechanism behind each expression. CNeo-Bench is paired with a two-tier evaluation framework that separates whether a model can descr

summary.core_problem: 评测 LLM 是否理解中文新词的构词机制，而不只是能生成近似释义。
summary.importance: 贡献是中文新词 benchmark 和分层评测协议。它对 tokenizer、中文预训练语料覆盖、字符级/音形义表示有间接参考价值，但还不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CNeo-Bench，收集 4,759 个中文新词及参考定义，并按语言机制划分为 5 个一级类别和 9 个子类别。评测分两层：一层看模型能否解释新词含义，另一层看模型能否操作其底层机制，例如源形式还原。
summary.experiments: 评测 18 个 LLM。多数模型在 definition generation 上低于 40%。若干子类出现 recognition-manipulation gap：模型能描述新词含义，却在 source-form restoration 中用语义等价表达替代原始形式。另有 1,05 开头规模的 few-shot 分析，但摘要被截断，无法确认完整样本量和结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The University of Tokyo、小红书和 Tsinghua University。Yoshimasa Tsuruoka 是长期从事 NLP 与机器学习研究的学者。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether LLMs understand the formation mechanisms of Chinese neologisms, rather than merely producing approximate definitions.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is a Chinese neologism benchmark with a two-tier evaluation protocol. It is indirectly useful for tokenizer design, Chinese pretraining coverage, and character/phonetic/visual representation analysis, but it is not a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: CNeo-Bench contains 4,759 Chinese neologisms with reference definitions, organized into five top-level mechanism categories and nine subcategories. The evaluation separates definition generation from mechanism-level operations such as restoring the source form.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates 18 LLMs. Most models score below 40% on definition generation. Several subcategories show a recognition-manipulation gap: models can describe a neologism but replace the required source form with a semantic paraphrase in restoration tasks. The abstract mentions a few-shot analysis over a 1,05*-sized subset, but the full number and details are truncated.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The University of Tokyo, Xiaohongshu Inc., and Tsinghua University. Yoshimasa Tsuruoka is a well-known NLP and machine learning researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读任务设计即可；它暴露的是中文 tokenizer/语料覆盖的盲区，不是模型推理能力本身。
recommendation.en: Read the task design only; it exposes Chinese tokenizer and corpus-coverage blind spots more than general reasoning failure.

paper.title: When Is Noise Response Universal? Tokenization as the Hidden Variable in Language Models
paper.abstract: The performance of textual neural models often degrades when their inputs are corrupted by noise such as typos, OCR errors, or dropped words. We study the degradation rate across neural models, both sentence embeddings and decoder-only LLMs, and find that how consistent it is depends on the scale of the noise: under word-level noise, models with very different architectures decline along nearly the same curve, while under character-level noise they separate. We further identify the determining f

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究文本模型在噪声输入下的性能退化是否具有普适规律，并指出此前看起来像“架构差异”的现象，隐藏变量其实是 tokenization。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员有直接价值，因为它把鲁棒性问题从模糊的“模型抗噪差异”收缩到更可操作的 tokenizer 与训练目标上。贡献类型是机制分析加可操作结论：词级噪声下退化曲线近似普适，字符级噪声下差异主要由分词重切分放大。这会影响 tokenizer 设计、噪声数据增强、OCR/拼写鲁棒性评估，甚至影响对不同预训练目标的比较方式。
summary.technical_approach: 作者同时考察 sentence embedding 模型和 decoder-only LLM，在 word-level 与 character-level 两类噪声下比较退化曲线。核心发现有两层：第一，决定退化一致性的关键不是架构，而是训练目标；八个来自六种预训练范式的 encoder 初始表现分散，但经过短程 contrastive training 后会收敛到共同曲线。第二，词级/字符级分裂来自 tokenization 机制：单个字符编辑会迫使 tokenizer 对周围词重新切分，导致 token 序列扰动远大于整词删除。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到覆盖多种句向量模型与 decoder-only LLM，并比较八个 encoder、六种预训练范式，但未给出具体参数规模。实验设计的价值在于把噪声尺度、训练目标和 tokenizer 三者拆开：在 word-level noise 下，不同模型沿近似相同曲线退化；在 character-level noise 下，模型开始明显分化。再通过短程对比学习把 encoder 拉到共同曲线，支持“objective 而非 architecture”这一判断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether performance degradation under textual noise follows a universal law across language models, and argues that the hidden variable behind apparent model differences is tokenization.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining researchers because it reframes robustness from a vague architecture-level property into something more actionable: tokenizer behavior and training objective. The contribution is a mechanism analysis with practical consequences: degradation is nearly universal under word-level noise, while character-level divergence is largely driven by retokenization effects. That matters for tokenizer design, noise augmentation, OCR/typo robustness, and even how we compare pretraining objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors study both sentence encoders and decoder-only LLMs under word-level and character-level corruption. Two main claims emerge. First, the key factor behind degradation consistency is the training objective rather than architecture: eight encoders from six pretraining paradigms start scattered but collapse onto a common curve after a short contrastive-training recipe. Second, the word-vs-character split is explained by tokenization: a single character edit forces the tokenizer to resegment the surrounding word, causing much larger token-sequence disruption than dropping an entire word.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions multiple sentence embedding models and decoder-only LLMs, including eight encoders spanning six pretraining paradigms, though exact parameter scales are not given. The experimental value lies in disentangling noise scale, objective, and tokenization: under word-level noise, very different models degrade along nearly the same curve; under character-level noise, they separate. A short contrastive-training stage then collapses encoder behavior onto a common curve, supporting the objective-over-architecture claim.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改你对“抗噪=架构能力”的直觉：先看 tokenizer-induced retokenization 这个机制，再决定要不要做噪声增强；值得在内部 tokenizer ablation 里立刻复现。
recommendation.en: This should update the instinct that robustness is mainly architectural: inspect the tokenizer-induced retokenization mechanism first, then decide whether noise augmentation is even the right lever; worth reproducing in internal tokenizer ablations.

paper.title: Lost in Compression: A Controlled Cross-Lingual Audit of Extractive Prompt Compressors
paper.abstract: Extractive prompt compression promises to cut LLM inference costs by removing low-information tokens, and learned compressors such as LLMLingua-2 report strong results on English benchmarks. Most other languages already pay a token premium: the same content costs 1.3-1.8x more tokens than in English. We ask whether compression closes or widens this gap. Using fully parallel data in ten languages spanning five scripts, with controls budget-matched in the target model's tokenizer, we audit four le

summary.core_problem: 检验英文监督训练的抽取式 prompt compressor 在多语言场景下是否真的降低推理 token 成本，还是会扩大非英语用户的成本与质量差距。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控审计与推理效率分析。它把 prompt compression 从英文 benchmark 扩展到跨语言公平性和 tokenizer 成本问题，对 serving 成本、tokenizer 设计、多语数据覆盖都有间接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 使用十种语言、五种文字系统的完全平行数据，在目标模型 tokenizer 下做预算匹配控制。比较四个学习式压缩器与四个确定性 baseline，其中包括 LLMLingua-2 的 XLM-R/mBERT 版本、生产栈中的 Kompress-v2，以及多语言训练的 XProvence。
summary.experiments: 覆盖来自十个供应商的十一个目标模型，总计超过 250,000 次评测调用。摘要报告非英语本来有 1.3-1.8 倍 token premium；在 0.33 keep-rate 下，英文保留 normalized content 的 57-62%，跨语言迁移差距稳定复现，并且对压缩率高度敏感。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper audits whether extractive prompt compressors trained mostly with English supervision reduce multilingual inference cost, or instead widen the gap for non-English users.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled audit of inference efficiency. It connects prompt compression with multilingual cost, tokenizer bias, and serving behavior, which is indirectly relevant to pretraining through tokenizer and multilingual data coverage decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses fully parallel data in ten languages across five scripts, with compression budgets matched in each target model's tokenizer. It compares four learned compressors against four deterministic baselines, including LLMLingua-2 variants, Kompress-v2 from a production stack, and the multilingual XProvence compressor.
summary_en.experiments: The audit runs on eleven target models from ten vendors with more than 250,000 evaluation calls. The abstract reports a 1.3-1.8x token premium for non-English content and a robust transfer gap; at a 0.33 keep rate, English retains 57-62% of normalized content, with strong rate dependence.

recommendation.zh: 结论像 serving 侧问题，但多语 tokenizer 和英文监督迁移的失真值得记；看实验控制和 rate 曲线即可。
recommendation.en: Mostly a serving-side audit, but the multilingual tokenizer and English-supervision failure mode is worth noting; read the controls and rate curves.

paper.title: The Dialect Tax: Dialectal Biases Persist throughout the Language Modeling Pipeline
paper.abstract: Systematic dialectal performance gaps in language models (LMs) are well documented, but the source of these disparities within the modern language modeling pipeline remains unclear. Our study traces this "dialect tax" across the natural language processing pipeline. Using parallel English dialect corpora that hold meaning fixed while varying surface form, we first confirm that LMs recognize matched Standard American English (SAE) and dialectal texts as semantically equivalent. However, we discov

summary.core_problem: 追踪英语方言性能差距在 tokenizer、预训练、后训练和推理链路中的来源，而不是只在最终任务指标上观察偏差。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是机制分析和偏差归因。它对预训练研究有直接价值，因为论文把方言差距连接到 tokenization、表示、梯度更新和生成行为，而不是停留在公平性 benchmark 层面。
summary.technical_approach: 论文使用保持语义不变、只改变表面方言形式的平行英语方言语料。先验证模型能识别 SAE 与方言文本语义等价，再检查 tokenization、表示空间、预训练梯度、后训练和推理输出中的差异。还构造字符级 counterfactual tokenizer，测试是否绕开传统子词切分就能消除不平等。
summary.experiments: 实验跨多个模型家族和代际。结果显示现代 LM 虽然能判断标准美式英语和方言文本语义等价，但仍在表示、tokenization、训练梯度和推理输出上编码不对称。字符级 tokenizer 不能消除输入/输出不对称，也不能消除方言准确率差距。摘要还指出，预训练阶段方言配对样本会诱导比语义等价控制样本更发散的梯度更新。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper traces where dialectal performance gaps arise across the language modeling pipeline, including tokenization, pretraining, post-training, and inference.
summary_en.importance: This is a mechanistic bias attribution study with direct relevance to pretraining. It connects dialect gaps to tokenization, representations, gradient updates, and generation behavior rather than treating them only as downstream fairness metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors use parallel English dialect corpora that preserve meaning while varying surface form. They first test whether models recognize semantic equivalence between Standard American English and dialectal variants, then analyze tokenization, representation gaps, pretraining gradients, post-training behavior, and inference asymmetries. A character-level counterfactual tokenizer is used to test whether bypassing subword segmentation removes the gap.
summary_en.experiments: The study spans multiple model families and generations. Modern LMs recognize matched SAE and dialectal inputs as semantically equivalent, yet still encode them unequally through the pipeline. A character-level tokenizer does not remove input-output asymmetries or dialectal accuracy gaps. During pretraining, dialect pairs induce more divergent gradient updates than meaning-equivalent controls.

recommendation.zh: 只看 tokenizer 解释不够；建议读梯度分析部分，能校正数据清洗里对“非标准文本”的处理 prior。
recommendation.en: Tokenizer-only explanations are too shallow; read the gradient analysis to rethink how “non-standard” text is handled in data curation.

paper.title: PRQ-KMeans: Projection Residual Quantization for Semantic ID Tokenization
paper.abstract: Semantic identifiers (SIDs) represent entities as hierarchical token sequences for generative retrieval and recommendation. Residual-quantization tokenizers construct these sequences by selecting a codeword at each level and passing a residual to the next. We view this process as progressive commonality removal: each token captures a component shared within its group, while later tokens should model the remaining differences. This view reveals three limitations: a corpus-wide shared component ca

summary.core_problem: 如何改进残差量化（Residual Quantization）在构建语义标识符（Semantic IDs）时的分层 tokenization 过程，以解决容量浪费和硬分配带来的问题？
summary.importance: 针对生成式检索和推荐中的语义 ID tokenization，提出了一种改进的残差量化方法，从“渐进式共性去除”的视角优化了码字分配和残差计算。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PRQ-KMeans，在事后（post-hoc）设置下进行优化：1) 移除全局均值成分以节省首层容量；2) 使用 Top-k 相似度加权更新来细化质心，缓解硬分配问题；3) 替换全码字减法，避免在选定码字方向上留下残余变化。
summary.experiments: 在生成式检索和推荐任务上评估了 PRQ-KMeans 构建的语义 ID 的效果，但摘要未提供具体指标。

summary_en.core_problem: How to improve the hierarchical tokenization process of Residual Quantization for constructing Semantic IDs, addressing issues of capacity waste and hard assignment?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an improved residual quantization method for semantic ID tokenization in generative retrieval and recommendation, optimizing codeword assignment and residual computation from the perspective of 'progressive commonality removal'.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces PRQ-KMeans in a post-hoc setting: 1) removes the global-mean component to save first-level capacity; 2) refines centroids with Top-k similarity-weighted updates to mitigate hard assignment; 3) replaces full-codeword subtraction to avoid leaving residual variation along the selected-codeword direction.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated the effectiveness of semantic IDs constructed by PRQ-KMeans on generative retrieval and recommendation tasks, though specific metrics are not provided in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 关注离散化 tokenization（特别是用于检索/推荐的 Semantic ID）的研究员可作为 literature 备查，核心是改进残差量化的聚类过程。
recommendation.en: Researchers focusing on discrete tokenization (especially Semantic IDs for retrieval/recommendation) can keep this as literature reference; the core is improving the clustering process of residual quantization.

paper.title: Beyond Two Bytes per Letter: Tokenization Overhead in Cyrillic AI Systems
paper.abstract: Modern multilingual tokenizers often fragment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages more heavily than English, creating disparities in cost and context capacity. We quantify this overhead across nine production tokenizers and five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations, covering 8.37 million word forms. On a corpus benchmark, Ukrainian shows 68-121% token overhead on modern tokenizers and 220% on the older cl100k, measured through full-text fertil

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的是一个很具体、但对多语种基础模型很实际的问题：主流 byte-level BPE tokenizer 在英语主导的数据分布下，会系统性地把西里尔文字语言切得更碎，导致同样语义内容需要更多 token。论文不只停留在“乌克兰语更贵”这个现象层面，而是进一步区分了三件事：一是 UTF-8 字节长度带来的先天不利；二是训练语料中脚本和语言配比导致的 merge 学习不足；三是这种 token 开销如何传导到上下文容量、推理成本和真实应用效果。作者想回答的核心不是单纯测量 fertility，而是：这种开销到底有多大、是否主要由训练分布而非编码本身决定、以及在不改模型和改 tokenizer 两条路上分别能缓解多少。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的意义主要在 tokenizer 与数据配比，而不是下游应用。文章给出的结论很清楚：西里尔语言的 tokenization 劣势并不只是“字符占两个字节”这么简单，训练语料中对该脚本分配不足，会进一步放大 merge 稀缺，最终形成成本和上下文窗口上的结构性不平等。这个判断对多语种 tokenizer 设计、语料配比、词表预算分配都有直接启发。更重要的是，作者用受控实验说明，在 200K 词表上做更平衡的英乌联合训练，可以把 UK/EN token ratio 从 2.22× 压到 1.30×，说明问题相当大一部分是可训练、可修复的，而不是编码层面的硬约束。对做 multilingual pretrain 的人，这比单纯抱怨 fertility 更有用，因为它把问题落到了可操作的 recipe：数据配比、词表预算、脚本覆盖和 tokenizer retraining。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分成三块。第一块是系统测量。作者在五种有标准化西里尔/拉丁双书写形式的语言上做 cross-script 对照，包括 Ukrainian、Serbian、Kazakh、Azerbaijani、Moldovan，总计 8.37M 词形。核心指标是 corpus-level fertility，以及乌克兰语相对英语的 overhead 比值 R(t)=F(t,BrUK)/F(t,Brown)。这种设计的好处是把“语言本身信息密度”和“脚本/词表适配”尽量拆开：同一语言换脚本后 token 数变化，更接近 tokenizer 对脚本的偏置，而不是语义差异。

第二块是 tokenizer 重训实验。作者没有采用 post-hoc 往现有词表里补字符的路线，因为现代 tokenizer 里西里尔字符本身并不缺，真正缺的是高频子词 merge。于是他们直接训练 balanced byte-level BPE tokenizer，在固定 200K 词表上调节英乌语料配比，观察 fertility 和 UK/EN ratio 的变化。这个设计针对的是 merge 统计学习机制：如果训练语料里乌克兰语片段出现得足够多，BPE 会学到更长、更稳定的西里尔子词，从而降低 token 数。论文强调最佳 balanced tokenizer 实际在 158,184 个条目就收敛，说明不是词表越大越好，而是有效预算如何分配更关键。

第三块是推理时缓解。作者选用 LLMLingua-2 做 prompt compression，因为其 backbone 是 XLM-R，天然支持多语种，不需要为乌克兰语单独微调。这里的定位很克制：prompt compression 不是从根上修 tokenizer 偏置，而是作为 inference-time 补救手段，看看在真实业务 prompt 中能否部分回收上下文和成本损失。论文还加入 romanization 对照，目的不是鼓励改写脚本，而是检验“换成拉丁字母是否天然更省 token”。这一步很关键，因为它进一步支持作者的主张：token 开销不应被简单归因于 UTF-8 两字节，而要看 tokenizer 是否学到了对应脚本的 merge 结构。
summary.experiments:
实验最有信息量的结果有四组。

第一，生产 tokenizer 基准测试。作者评测了 9 个商用 tokenizer，在 BrUK 与 Brown 上计算 fertility。乌克兰语在现代 tokenizer 上相对英语有 68%–121% 的 token overhead，在较老的 cl100k 上达到 220%。这说明问题不是个别模型的偶然现象，而是跨 tokenizer 普遍存在，只是程度不同。

第二，跨语言脚本对照。五种语言的西里尔/拉丁标准写法比较显示，token overhead 会跟该语言在网络和训练语料中的主导书写系统一起变化。这个结果支持“训练分布决定 merge 质量”的解释，而不是把差异全部归结为 Unicode 编码长度。

第三，balanced tokenizer 重训。固定 200K 词表上，英乌平衡训练把 UK/EN ratio 从 2.22× 降到 1.30×，最佳 tokenizer 在 158,184 个实际词表项附近收敛，统计显著性给到 p < 0.0001。这个幅度很大，说明只靠 tokenizer 训练数据重配，就能回收相当一部分上下文浪费。

第四，真实应用验证。作者在 1,536 个真实电商商品样本上做 production-like benchmark，并用确定性准确率评估 prompt compression 等缓解手段。摘要截断没有给出全部数字，但从全文结构看，这部分的作用不是证明压缩方法本身多强，而是验证 corpus-level fertility 差异确实会传导到实际系统成本与可用上下文，并且 inference-time 压缩与 tokenizer 重训是互补而非替代关系。

另外一个值得注意的细节是，作者报告西里尔词表分配与 overhead 呈负相关，Spearman ρ = -0.536，但 p = 0.215，样本数只有 7。也就是说方向上符合直觉，但统计证据还不够硬。这个处理比较诚实，没有把弱相关包装成强结论。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，但如果你关心 multilingual tokenizer，建议重点看四处。

先看 Introduction 和 Related Work，作者把问题边界划得比较清楚：不是讨论语言能力，而是讨论 tokenization 造成的成本和上下文不平等；也不是字符缺失问题，而是 merge 不足问题。

然后看 Study 1 的 benchmark 设计，尤其是 fertility、R(t)、Δ_rom、Δ_cyr 这几个指标定义。这里决定了后面所有结论是否站得住。要特别注意作者如何用同语言双脚本对照来减少语义混杂。

第三个重点是 balanced tokenizer 实验。这部分最值得深挖，因为它直接回答“为什么重训 tokenizer，而不是做 post-hoc vocabulary patching”。如果你做多语种预训练，可以把这里当成一个小型 recipe 研究：固定词表预算下，语言配比如何影响 merge 学习和 token 效率。

最后看真实电商 benchmark 和 prompt compression 结果。这里不需要逐表细读，主要看作者如何把 corpus-level 指标连接到实际系统开销。预计 25–35 分钟可以抓住主要信息；如果要复现实验，重点抄 tokenizer 训练设置和语料配比细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a concrete but under-addressed pretraining issue: mainstream multilingual byte-level BPE tokenizers systematically over-segment Ukrainian and other underrepresented Cyrillic-script languages, so the same semantic content consumes many more tokens than English. The contribution is not just another fertility measurement. It tries to separate three factors: the UTF-8 byte disadvantage of Cyrillic, the lack of learned subword merges caused by English-heavy tokenizer training data, and the downstream effect on cost, latency, and usable context length. The central question is whether the overhead is mostly an unavoidable encoding artifact or a fixable consequence of tokenizer training allocation.
summary_en.importance: This is relevant to pretraining through tokenizer design and data mixture, not through downstream modeling. The main takeaway is that Cyrillic token inefficiency is not explained by “two bytes per character” alone. Training distribution matters a great deal: if a script receives too little mass during tokenizer training, BPE learns too few useful merges, and the language pays a recurring tax in context budget and inference cost. The strongest evidence is the balanced tokenizer experiment: under a 200K vocabulary cap, the Ukrainian/English token ratio drops from 2.22x to 1.30x. That is large enough to matter for multilingual pretraining recipes. For anyone building multilingual foundation models, this paper turns a fairness complaint into an actionable tokenizer/data-allocation problem.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has three methodological parts.

First, a controlled measurement study. The authors benchmark nine production tokenizers and evaluate five languages that have standardized Cyrillic and Latin representations: Ukrainian, Serbian, Kazakh, Azerbaijani, and Moldovan, totaling 8.37 million word forms. They use corpus-level fertility and define Ukrainian overhead relative to English as R(t)=F(t,BrUK)/F(t,Brown). The cross-script setup is important: comparing the same language in Cyrillic versus Latin helps isolate tokenizer-script mismatch from semantic or corpus-content differences.

Second, tokenizer retraining rather than post-hoc vocabulary patching. The paper argues that modern tokenizers already contain Cyrillic characters, so the bottleneck is not character absence but insufficient higher-order merges. To test this directly, they train balanced byte-level BPE tokenizers with different English-Ukrainian allocations under a fixed 200K vocabulary budget. The mechanism is straightforward: if Ukrainian appears often enough during tokenizer training, BPE can learn longer and more reusable Cyrillic subwords, reducing fragmentation. The best balanced tokenizer converges at 158,184 actual entries, which also suggests that effective allocation matters more than simply pushing vocabulary size upward.

Third, inference-time mitigation via prompt compression. They evaluate LLMLingua-2 because its XLM-R backbone is multilingual and can be applied to Ukrainian without language-specific fine-tuning. This is framed correctly as a mitigation, not a root-cause fix. The paper also includes a romanization comparison, not as a policy proposal but as a diagnostic: if Latinized Ukrainian is not consistently cheaper in a controlled setting, then UTF-8 byte length alone cannot explain the observed overhead.
summary_en.experiments:
There are four results worth retaining.

First, the production-tokenizer benchmark. Across nine commercial tokenizers, Ukrainian incurs 68% to 121% token overhead relative to English on modern tokenizers, and 220% on the older cl100k. This shows the issue is broad rather than model-specific.

Second, the cross-linguistic script comparison. For the five languages with standardized Cyrillic and Latin forms, the overhead tracks the script that is dominant in web usage and, by implication, in tokenizer training data. That pattern supports the training-allocation explanation more than a pure Unicode-byte explanation.

Third, balanced tokenizer retraining. With a 200K vocabulary cap, a balanced English-Ukrainian tokenizer reduces the UK/EN ratio from 2.22x to 1.30x, with the best model converging at 158,184 actual entries and reported significance at p < 0.0001. This is the most actionable result in the paper.

Fourth, a production-like benchmark on 1,536 real e-commerce products with deterministic evaluation. The full paper uses this section to show that corpus-level fertility differences propagate into practical prompt budgets, and that prompt compression and tokenizer retraining are complementary. The abstract excerpt does not expose all task-level numbers, but the role of this experiment is clear: it validates that the tokenization gap is operational, not merely corpus-analytic.

One careful detail deserves mention: the paper reports a negative association between Cyrillic vocabulary allocation and overhead (Spearman rho = -0.536), but it is not statistically significant (p = 0.215, n = 7). The direction is plausible; the evidence is still limited.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper unless you work directly on multilingual tokenization. Start with the metric definitions: fertility, R(t), Delta_rom, and Delta_cyr. Those choices determine whether the later claims are interpretable. Then read the cross-script design carefully, because that is the paper’s main control against semantic confounds.

The balanced tokenizer section is the part worth reading closely. It answers why retraining the tokenizer may be more effective than patching an existing vocabulary. If you care about multilingual pretraining, this section is the practical core: fixed vocabulary budget, changed language allocation, measurable change in token efficiency.

The prompt-compression and e-commerce sections can be read more selectively. Their value is in connecting tokenizer inefficiency to real system cost and context loss, not in introducing a new compression method. A focused read takes about 25 to 35 minutes. If you plan to reproduce or extend the work, spend the extra time on tokenizer training details and corpus composition.

recommendation.zh: 做 multilingual pretrain 或 tokenizer 的人该看；结论不新，但数字够硬，能提醒你别再默认英语 token budget 可直接外推到西里尔语。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you work on multilingual pretraining or tokenizers; not a paradigm shift, but the measurements are concrete enough to break the lazy assumption that English token budgets transfer to Cyrillic.

paper.title: Lexical Perturbations Disrupt LLM Reasoning: An Empirical Study of Attention Diversion
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong reasoning performance, but their robustness to realistic lexical corruption remains poorly understood. We evaluate four open-weight instruction-tuned models and frontier models across four reasoning benchmarks under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. Character-level perturbations substantially degrade accuracy, especially on multi-step reasoning tasks, while filler insertion has little effect. We trace this asymmetry to Attention Di

summary.core_problem: 研究真实词汇级扰动为何会显著破坏 LLM 推理，尤其是字符噪声与子词切分碎片化带来的注意力偏移机制。
summary.importance: 这类工作不直接推进预训练 recipe，但对 tokenizer 设计、鲁棒性训练和推理失效诊断有参考价值。贡献主要是机制分析：把性能下降归因到 token fragmentation 引发的 attention diversion，而不是简单的输入变长。
summary.technical_approach: 作者在多种 lexical corruption 条件下评测开源与 frontier instruction-tuned 模型，包括键盘噪声、字符交换和 filler insertion。随后通过注意力分析、长度匹配对照和因子化干预，分离 prompt 变长、token 内容损坏与注意力重分配三种因素，提出 Attention Diversion 解释。
summary.experiments: 覆盖 4 个开源指令模型和若干 frontier 模型，在 4 个推理 benchmark 上测试。结论是字符级扰动会显著降低多步推理准确率，而 filler insertion 影响较小；长度匹配对照显示主要问题不是序列变长，而是 subword fragmentation；中后层注意力对碎片 token 分配异常偏高。摘要未给出具体提升或模型规模，因此更适合作为现象论文阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why realistic lexical perturbations strongly disrupt LLM reasoning, focusing on how character noise and subword fragmentation divert attention.
summary_en.importance: It does not directly advance pretraining recipes, but it is useful for tokenizer design, robustness training, and failure diagnosis. The main contribution is mechanistic: performance loss is attributed to attention diversion caused by token fragmentation rather than mere prompt length increase.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate open-weight and frontier instruction-tuned models under keyboard noise, character swaps, and filler insertion. They then use attention analysis, length-matched controls, and factorial interventions to separate the effects of sequence length, corrupted token content, and attention redistribution, proposing the Attention Diversion account.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers four open-weight instruction-tuned models plus frontier models on four reasoning benchmarks. Character-level perturbations substantially hurt multi-step reasoning, while filler insertion has limited effect. Length-matched controls suggest the main culprit is subword fragmentation rather than longer inputs, and middle-to-late layers over-attend to fragmented tokens. The abstract does not provide exact model sizes or effect magnitudes, so this is best treated as a phenomenon paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是方法论文，但 tokenizer/鲁棒性方向的人该看；只读长度匹配对照和中后层 attention 分析，若实验干净，说明很多“噪声鲁棒性差”其实是分词器债务。
recommendation.en: Not a methods paper, but worth a look if you care about tokenization or robustness; read the length-matched controls and mid/late-layer attention analysis first.

paper.title: SuTRA : Structurally-Unified Tokenization with Root Awareness
paper.abstract: Existing subword tokenizers optimize statistical compression but ignore morphological structure, particularly the relationship between roots and affixes. This is harmful for morphologically rich Indic languages, where basic units are complex orthographic syllables (aksharas) rather than letters. Frequency-based methods over-fragment words, arbitrarily splitting roots and affixes - a phenomenon we term Morphological Shattering. We propose SuTRA (Structurally-Unified Tokenization with Root Awarene

summary.core_problem: 解决 BPE 等频率驱动 tokenizer 在印地语、马拉地语、古吉拉特语等形态丰富语言中切碎词根和词缀的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer 方法和数据贡献。Tokenizer 是预训练接口层，形态结构被错误切分会影响表示共享、低资源泛化和跨语言迁移；这篇工作把压缩效率与形态边界之间的取舍明确化。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SuTRA，即 Structurally-Unified Tokenization with Root Awareness。方法保留 akshara 这类印度文字正字音节的不可分性，并在 merge 时惩罚跨越形态边界的合并，从而减少 Morphological Shattering。论文还发布了 Hindi、Marathi、Gujarati 的形态切分数据集。
summary.experiments: 相对 BPE，SuTRA 在 morphological alignment 的 Boundary F1 上最高提升 14.7%，在 Hindi semantic recoverability 上提升 34%，并在机器翻译中平均提升 8.08 chrF2。摘要未报告大规模 LM 预训练或困惑度实验。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Indian Institute of Technology Bombay。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles the tendency of frequency-based tokenizers such as BPE to split roots and affixes incorrectly in morphologically rich Indic languages.
summary_en.importance: This is a tokenizer and data contribution. Tokenization is part of the pretraining interface, and morphology-breaking segmentation can affect representation sharing, low-resource generalization, and cross-lingual transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach: SuTRA preserves akshara indivisibility and penalizes merges that cross morphological boundaries. It explicitly optimizes for root awareness rather than pure statistical compression, and releases a morphological segmentation dataset for Hindi, Marathi, and Gujarati.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with BPE, SuTRA reports up to +14.7% Boundary F1 in morphological alignment, +34% semantic recoverability on Hindi, and an average +8.08 chrF2 improvement in machine translation. The abstract does not report large-scale LM pretraining or perplexity experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay.

recommendation.zh: Tokenizer 方向值得扫方法；缺少大模型预训练 ablation，先把形态边界惩罚当多语种 tokenizer 设计候选项。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for tokenizer design; without large-LM pretraining ablations, treat morphology-aware merge penalties as a candidate idea, not a settled recipe.

paper.title: Why GPT-Style Models Do Not Directly Transfer to Symbolic Music: Compression in the Wrong Coordinate System
paper.abstract: GPT-style models achieve strong performance by representing language with finite vocabularies of reusable discrete tokens. This success has motivated symbolic music tokenizations to treat recurring musical structures, such as chords, motifs, and phrases, as reusable units analogous to linguistic tokens. However, tokenization derives its advantage not from reusable combinations alone, but from compression: effective compression requires coordinates in which recurring regularities form stable and

summary.core_problem: 解释 GPT 式离散 tokenization 为什么不能直接迁移到 symbolic music：问题不在 token 是否可复用，而在坐标系是否让音乐事实可预测压缩。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer/表示学习的概念框架。它把音乐 tokenization 从“发现更大组合单元”转为“寻找 predictively effective 且 relationally lossless 的坐标系统”，对跨模态 LM tokenizer 设计有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Effectiveness--Losslessness Framework，把 tokenization 定义为构造既有预测有效性又保持关系无损的坐标系统。Predictive Effectiveness Principle 进一步定义 Fact--Token Boundary，强调通过 decoupling 和 denesting 找到让条件分布稳定的表示，而不是直接把 chord、motif、phrase 当作语言 token 类比物。
summary.experiments: 摘要更像理论/立场论文，未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或数值结果。无法确认是否有系统实验验证该 tokenization 框架。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that GPT-style tokenization does not transfer directly to symbolic music because music is being compressed in the wrong coordinate system.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conceptual framework for tokenization and representation. It reframes symbolic music tokenization from finding reusable larger units to finding coordinates where musical facts become predictively compressible while preserving relations.
summary_en.technical_approach: It proposes an Effectiveness--Losslessness Framework, defining tokenization as the construction of a predictively effective and relationally lossless coordinate system. The Predictive Effectiveness Principle introduces a Fact--Token Boundary and emphasizes decoupling and denesting rather than treating chords, motifs, and phrases as direct analogues of linguistic tokens.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reads as a theoretical or position-style paper. It does not provide model sizes, training corpora, baselines, or numerical results, so empirical support cannot be assessed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 作为 tokenizer taste note 值得扫摘要；没有实验时别采信结论，但“坐标系先于词表”这个提醒是对的。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming as a tokenizer taste note; without experiments the claims are weak, but the “coordinate system before vocabulary” point is useful.

paper.title: A Pilot Study of Autocompleting Tokenizers
paper.abstract: Modern input methods routinely rely on autocomplete to omit information that can be recovered from local context. Inspired by these autocomplete-assisted writing systems, we investigate whether Transformer inputs can be compressed in a similar manner. Byte-level tokenization offers a simple and language-independent alternative to subword tokenization, but its longer input sequences typically result in increased computational cost and reduced model quality. We propose a compression scheme that em

summary.core_problem: 探索能否像输入法自动补全一样，删除局部上下文可预测的 byte，从而降低 byte-level Transformer 的输入长度。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer/输入表示的 pilot study。它关心 byte-level tokenization 的核心缺点：语言无关但序列更长、计算更贵、质量更容易受损。对预训练研究的价值在于把“tokenizer 压缩”改写为“先预测再省略”的动态表示问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法使用一个轻量自回归 byte language model 判断哪些源语言 byte 可由邻近上下文轻松预测，并在送入标准 encoder-decoder Transformer 前删除这些 byte。压缩后的表示仍用于常规机器翻译训练或推理。技术上是对 byte 输入的动态剪枝，而不是固定 BPE 词表设计。
summary.experiments: 实验在机器翻译上进行，摘要明确提到 English-French。结果显示可省略大量源语言 byte，且最佳方法在 English-French 上保持翻译质量不下降。摘要未给出模型参数量、压缩率、BLEU/COMET 数字或更多语言对结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether byte-level Transformer inputs can be shortened by omitting bytes that are predictable from local context, similar to autocomplete in input methods.
summary_en.importance: This is a pilot study on tokenization and input representation. It targets the main weakness of byte-level tokenization: language independence comes with longer sequences, higher compute, and often lower model quality. For pretraining work, it reframes tokenizer compression as dynamic omission based on predictability.
summary_en.technical_approach: A lightweight autoregressive byte language model identifies source-language bytes that can be easily predicted from surrounding context, and these bytes are removed before a standard encoder-decoder Transformer processes the input. The method is dynamic byte-level pruning rather than a fixed subword vocabulary design.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are on machine translation, with English-French explicitly mentioned in the abstract. The best method preserves translation performance while omitting a substantial fraction of source bytes. The abstract does not provide parameter counts, compression ratios, BLEU/COMET numbers, or broad multilingual evidence.

recommendation.zh: 想做 byte tokenizer 可扫一眼；证据还停在 MT pilot，但动态省略比调 BPE 表有意思。
recommendation.en: Skim if you care about byte tokenizers; the evidence is still an MT pilot, but dynamic omission is more interesting than another BPE tweak.

paper.title: Numeracy in Large Language Models: Fundamental Limitations and Paths to Improvement
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong results on mathematical reasoning benchmarks yet remain unreliable on elementary numerical tasks, including magnitude comparison, large-integer arithmetic, fractions, and scientific notation. This survey examines basic numerical understanding as a capability distinct from high-level mathematical reasoning. We propose the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeracy into Representational Grounding (RG), mapping numeral forms to value,

summary.core_problem: 现有前沿LLM在高阶数学推理任务上表现接近人类水平，但在最基础的数值任务（大数量级比较、大整数加法、基础分数运算、科学计数法操作）上存在系统性失效。已有研究多将这类问题归为高阶数学推理能力不足的附属表现，未将基础数感作为独立研究对象，缺乏统一分析框架区分基础数感与高阶数学推理，也没有系统梳理数感失效的模式、根因与改进路径。
summary.importance: 数感缺陷的根源来自预训练阶段的基础设计选择，包括tokenizer构造、训练数据中的数值表示方式、模型原生的算法执行能力，这些问题无法仅靠SFT/RL阶段刷高阶数学benchmark解决。提出的二维接地框架可以帮助研究者在改进定量能力时，区分是表示层缺陷还是过程层缺陷，避免干预方向错位——只针对高阶推理做优化，却没有修复底层数值处理的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 提出数值接地框架（Numerical Grounding Framework, NGF），将数值能力拆解为两个正交维度：表示接地（Representational Grounding, RG），即数字表面形式到内部表示的映射能可靠保留序关系、量级大小、不同格式的等价性；过程接地（Procedural Grounding, PG），即算术操作的执行过程与输出符合数学定义。基于该框架，工作系统梳理了8个与LLM数感相关的研究方向，整理了评测体系从GSM8K、MATH这类饱和的高阶数学基准，向NumericBench、Number Cookbook、GSM-Symbolic等新一代诊断性数值基准演进的脉络，将典型数值失效归为四类：对问题表面表述的脆弱性、Tokenizer引入的伪影、长度泛化失败、算法不对称性，并逐类对应分析架构、数据、训练流程层面的根因与已验证的缓解方案。
summary.experiments: 作为综述类工作，未开展新的大规模模型训练实验，核心贡献是对现有实证结果做结构化整合：已公开的测试显示，前沿模型会稳定出现9.11>9.9这类基础量级比较错误，大整数加法精度随数字位数增加快速下跌，基础数感能力随模型规模的scaling效应极弱——参数规模增长不会自然带来基础数值处理能力的可靠提升。现有干预手段中，调整数字的tokenization策略、显式构建数值内部表示、过程监督对过程接地类失效有可测量的改善，但表示接地类失效目前尚无通用解决方案。
summary.reading_guide: 该工作为综述体裁，无需逐字通读。重点关注第3章的NGF框架定义、失效模式分类，以及根因与改进方案的映射关系，核心内容约1小时可读完。无需花费时间在罗列相关工作的部分，重点关注其中提到的Tokenizer对数字的拆分影响、基础数感不随模型规模有效scaling的实证结论，这些内容对预训练阶段的tokenizer设计、数据构造有直接参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: Frontier LLMs achieve near-human performance on high-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks but systematically fail on elementary numerical tasks including magnitude comparison, large-integer addition, fraction arithmetic, and scientific notation operations. Existing work treats these failures as secondary side effects of poor general mathematical reasoning, and does not treat basic numeracy as a distinct research object. No unified analytical framework exists to separate basic numeracy from high-level mathematical cognition, or to systematically map failure modes, root causes, and mitigation paths.
summary_en.importance: These numeracy failures trace back to fundamental pretrain design choices including tokenizer construction, numeric representation in training data, and the model's native capacity for algorithmic execution—issues that cannot be resolved by post-training on advanced math benchmarks alone. The proposed two-dimensional grounding framework helps researchers disentangle representational flaws from procedural flaws when improving quantitative capability, avoiding misaligned interventions that target high-level reasoning while leaving primitive numeric processing unaddressed.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work introduces the Numerical Grounding Framework (NGF), which decomposes numeric competence into two orthogonal dimensions: Representational Grounding (RG), the faithful mapping from surface numeral forms to internal representations that preserve ordering, magnitude, and format equivalence; and Procedural Grounding (PG), the faithful execution of arithmetic procedures consistent with formal mathematical definitions. Using NGF as an organizing lens, the work synthesizes eight related research strands, traces the evaluation shift from saturated high-level math benchmarks (GSM8K, MATH) to new diagnostic numeracy benchmarks (NumericBench, Number Cookbook, GSM-Symbolic, etc.), categorizes numeracy failures into four classes (fragility to surface phrasing, tokenization artifacts, length generalization failure, algorithmic asymmetry), and maps each failure class to architectural, data, and training root causes alongside documented mitigation strategies.
summary_en.experiments: As a research synthesis, the work does not report new large-scale model training results. It consolidates existing empirical findings: frontier models routinely produce magnitude comparison errors such as claiming 9.11 > 9.9, large-integer addition accuracy degrades rapidly with digit length, and basic numeracy exhibits very weak scaling with model size—increasing parameter count does not reliably improve primitive numeric processing. Among documented interventions, adjusted numeric tokenization, explicit internal numeric representations, and process supervision show measurable effects on PG failures, while no general solution exists for RG failures.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a structured review; close line-by-line reading is not required. Focus on the NGF definition, failure mode taxonomy, and the mapping between root causes and mitigation strategies in Section 3. Core content can be covered in roughly one hour. Skip exhaustive listings of tangentially related work, and pay specific attention to documented effects of tokenizer digit splitting and the weak scaling of basic numeracy, as these carry direct implications for pretraining data and tokenizer design.

recommendation.zh: 把数值能力拆解为表征接地和过程接地两个维度，覆盖tokenizer、预训练数据分布的影响，做预训练数据或tokenizer设计的重点看§3的NGF框架和失败模式梳理。
recommendation.en: Decomposes numeracy into representational and procedural grounding, covering tokenizer and pretraining data distribution effects. Teams working on pretraining data or tokenizer design should focus on §3 for the NGF framework and failure mode review.

paper.title: Mind the Cap: Output-Budget Regimes Change the Measured Multilingual Reasoning Gap
paper.abstract: Multilingual evaluations report accuracy at a single output-token cap, but languages need different numbers of tokens to express the same content, so the cap is a hidden experimental variable. We test whether the native-vs-translate gap on MGSM (German, Thai, Swahili) is a token-budget artifact for Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four prompting strategies. The measured gap swings by up to 57 points across budgets, length normalization moves it by up to 38.9 points where the cap binds, a

summary.core_problem: 多语言推理评测中的输出 token 上限会改变 native prompting 与 translate prompting 的测量差距，导致所谓“多语言推理差距”被预算设置污染。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是评测协议分析。它指出固定 output cap 不是无害实现细节，而是会影响多语言 reasoning accuracy、策略排序和 gap 解释的实验变量；这对预训练研究员做 multilingual eval、reasoning eval 和 tokenizer 相关比较都有直接提醒。
summary.technical_approach: 论文在 MGSM 的德语、泰语、斯瓦希里语上，对 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct 使用四种 prompting 策略，并系统扫不同输出预算。核心处理包括 hard cap 解码、长度归一化、预先冻结峰值和近零点，再用独立大规模解码做 Holm-corrected 假设检验。
summary.experiments: 实验模型为 Qwen3-8B 和 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct；数据为 MGSM 三种语言。摘要报告 native-vs-translate gap 可随预算变化最多摆动 57 个点；在 cap 绑定时，长度归一化可移动 gap 最多 38.9 个点；紧预算下甚至会反转 prompting 策略排序。作者还对冻结的 Qwen 峰值和 B*=1024 附近设置做了 540,000 次独立 hard-capped decodes，并进行六个 Holm 校正检验。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper shows that output-token caps can change the measured native-versus-translate gap in multilingual reasoning evaluations, making the reported gap partly a budget artifact.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation-protocol contribution. It treats the output cap as an experimental variable rather than a harmless decoding detail, with direct implications for multilingual reasoning evaluation, tokenizer-sensitive comparisons, and pretraining model assessment.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors evaluate German, Thai, and Swahili MGSM using Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct under four prompting strategies and multiple output-budget regimes. They use hard-capped decoding, length normalization, prospectively frozen peaks and near-zero points, and independent large-scale decodes with Holm-corrected tests.
summary_en.experiments: The study uses Qwen3-8B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on three MGSM languages. The abstract reports that the native-versus-translate gap can swing by up to 57 points across budgets, length normalization can shift the gap by up to 38.9 points when the cap binds, and tight caps can reverse which prompting strategy appears better. A follow-up test uses 540,000 independently hard-capped decodes for frozen Qwen settings and six Holm-corrected tests.

recommendation.zh: 应把 output cap 当成 eval 超参记录；只看预算扫图和 Holm 检验，足够改变多语言推理评测习惯。
recommendation.en: Treat output cap as an eval hyperparameter; the budget sweep and Holm tests are enough to change multilingual reasoning eval practice.

paper.title: Attention is Case-Sensitive
paper.abstract: In human visual perception, uppercase lettering serves as a natural salience cue that captures attention within lowercase text. In this paper, we present a systematic empirical characterization study revealing that Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit an analogous property: letter casing modulates internal attention allocation. Through analysis across 13 models, nine LLMs and four Vision-Language Models (VLMs), with diverse tokenization schemes, we show that formatting target information in alte

summary.core_problem: 字母大小写差异通常被视为tokenizer的被动附带产物，此前没有系统研究预训练Transformer（包括LLM和VLM）中是否存在类似人类视觉感知的、由大小写调节内部注意力分配的效应，以及该效应的边界条件。
summary.importance: 揭示了预训练过程中Transformer会将排版大小写内隐学习为一种潜在的注意力优先级信号，而非无关紧要的tokenization细节。这一发现有助于理解预训练数据中的表层排版特征如何塑造模型内部行为，为注意力操控、模型可解释性研究提供了新的切入角度。推理模型与非推理模型的效应差异也为理解推理过程的语义重对齐功能提供了实证依据。
summary.technical_approach: 研究采用完全训练无关的实验范式，仅在tokenization之前修改输入文本的大小写，严格保持词序和语义不变。实验设计将目标span（标注的正确答案span或对应图像区域的文本描述）设置为大写或交替大小写、周围上下文保持小写，同时设置反向干预（上下文大写、目标小写）用于因果验证。评估覆盖13个模型：9个LLM（7个非推理、2个推理）和4个VLM（2个非推理、2个推理），涵盖不同规模和tokenizer类型。测量指标包括目标span上的跨层注意力集中度变化，以及下游任务性能的变化。核心贡献是系统刻画了此前未被充分研究的“大小写显著性”效应，以及发现推理模型的审慎推理过程会过滤这类表层排版信号。
summary.experiments: 大小写显著性效应在所有被测非推理LLM中普遍存在：格式化为大写或交替大小写的目标span，跨层注意力集中度显著提升。该效应延伸到VLM场景：将文本描述中的目标词改为大写，会使图像注意力向对应视觉区域偏移。反向干预实验中，大写上下文中的小写目标注意力下降，验证了大小写变化的因果作用。注意力集中度提升并不总能改善下游性能，根据任务上下文不同可能带来提升也可能造成下降。推理模型在文本任务中的大小写效应明显减弱，因为其审慎推理过程会进行语义重对齐，优先保证逻辑一致性而非遵循表层排版信号。所有实验仅通过prompt层面的大小写修改实现，未进行微调、添加适配器或运行时模型内部探测。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言中的问题提出、方法论部分的控制变量设计（如何排除语义混淆因素），以及推理模型与非推理模型的对比结果。无需深挖数学细节，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。从事可解释性或注意力操控研究的读者可额外关注因果分析的实验设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Letter case variation is conventionally treated as a passive artifact of tokenization. There is no systematic characterization of whether typographic case modulates internal attention allocation in pretrained LLMs and VLMs — analogous to the case-based salience effect observed in human visual perception — nor of the boundary conditions of such an effect.
summary_en.importance: The findings demonstrate that pretrained transformers implicitly internalize typographic case as a latent attention priority signal during pretraining, rather than it being a trivial tokenization quirk. This informs understanding of how surface-level formatting features in pretraining data shape model internal behavior, and provides a new angle for attention steering and interpretability research. The observed difference between reasoning and non-reasoning models also offers empirical evidence for the semantic realignment function of deliberative reasoning processes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses an entirely training-free experimental paradigm: it modifies only the letter case of input text before tokenization, while strictly preserving word order and semantic content. The experimental design formats target spans (ground-truth answer spans or text descriptions corresponding to image regions) in uppercase or alternating case against a lowercase context, and runs reverse interventions (uppercase context, lowercase targets) for causal validation. The evaluation covers 13 models: 9 LLMs (7 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) and 4 VLMs (2 non-reasoning, 2 reasoning) across different scales and tokenizer types. Measured outcomes include changes in cross-layer attention concentration on target spans, as well as downstream task performance shifts. Core contributions include systematic characterization of the under-explored "casing-salience" effect, and the finding that deliberative reasoning processes in reasoning models filter out such surface-level typographic cues.
summary_en.experiments: The casing-salience effect is universal across all evaluated non-reasoning LLMs: target spans formatted in uppercase or alternating case show significantly higher cross-layer attention concentration. The effect extends to VLMs: uppercasing target words in text descriptions shifts image attention toward corresponding visual regions. Reverse intervention experiments reduce attention on lowercase targets embedded in uppercase context, confirming the causal role of case variation. Increased attention concentration does not consistently improve downstream performance — it can lead to both gains and degradations depending on task context. Reasoning models show weakened casing effects in text tasks, as their deliberative reasoning process performs semantic realignment that prioritizes logical coherence over surface typographic signals. All experiments use only prompt-level case modification, with no fine-tuning, adapters, or runtime model introspection.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem framing in the introduction, the controlled variable design in the methodology (how semantic confounders are excluded), and the comparison results between reasoning and non-reasoning models. No deep dive into mathematical details is needed; estimated reading time is 20–30 minutes. Researchers working on interpretability or attention steering may pay extra attention to the causal analysis experiment design.

recommendation.zh: 这篇改变的是对“格式噪声无害”的默认假设；先看 attention-performance divergence 的图。
recommendation.en: This weakens the default assumption that casing is harmless formatting noise; start with the attention-performance divergence plots.

paper.title: TokTier: Exact Stateful Tokenization for Agentic LLM Serving
paper.abstract: LLM serving systems cache prompt KV state, yet most front ends still re-tokenize the full request text on every call. The cost lands on coding agents, which resubmit a long transcript after each small tool result, and reuse is hard because even a short append can change token boundaries near the end of the previous sequence. Across 153,951 calls from two agent ecosystems, the median call appends about 1.4K characters, and only 1.0-3.6% of calls start or rebuild a session with contexts of million

summary.core_problem: TokTier 解决的是 agentic LLM serving 中一个容易被低估的前端瓶颈：KV prefix cache 已经避免了模型重复处理长前缀，但 tokenizer 仍然在每次请求时重新扫描完整 transcript。编码 agent 的请求模式会放大这个问题，因为大多数调用只是向已有会话追加一小段工具结果，但请求文本会携带完整历史。难点在于 tokenization 不是简单可拼接的，追加少量文本也可能改变旧文本尾部的 token 边界，因此不能只按 byte prefix 复用旧 token IDs。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对长上下文、agent serving 和 tokenizer 工程有明确启发。它说明当 prompt-cache 命中率接近 0.99 时，tokenization 可以从 TTFT 的 10% 上升到 64%，成为前端主要延迟来源。对基座模型研究者来说，价值在两个方面：第一，tokenizer 不只是离线预处理组件，它会影响长上下文和 agent workload 的 serving 成本；第二，tokenizer 的“精确等价”约束很硬，任何近似、启发式 overlap 或非等价 GPU tokenizer 都可能改变模型输入和 cache key。
summary.technical_approach: TokTier 将请求分成两条路径。对于会话 continuation，它保存每个 live session 的 token IDs 和 byte spans。新请求到来时，只重新 tokenize 新增文本加旧上下文的一个小后缀，然后把新 token 记录和缓存 token 记录进行比对。只有通过 stable boundary check 时才 splice 缓存前缀；这个检查用于证明 pre-tokenizer 不会跨过该边界观察更远文本。如果检查失败，窗口会逐步扩大，最后退回完整 reference tokenizer，因此失败只增加延迟，不改变输出。对于没有可复用前缀的 full-context 请求，TokTier 给 GPT-family tokenizer 构造了等价的 GPU tokenization 路径。它把输入分解成 maximal character-class runs，用 run 内位置、邻近文本和 run-level summaries 推导 regex pre-tokenization 的 piece starts，从而绕开通常的 leftmost-first sequential regex scan。之后使用 GPU BPE pipeline 编码 pieces；短片段仍走 CPU。系统还使用 content-addressed tokenizer registry 和后台 verifier，对线上请求采样并与 reference implementation 比较，避免执行历史相关 bug 破坏精确性。
summary.experiments: 论文报告了两类 workload 特征和系统结果。数据侧，来自两个 agent ecosystem 的 153,951 次调用显示，median append 约 1.4K characters，只有 1.0–3.6% 的调用是新会话或重建会话；fleet-level prompt-cache hit rate 为 94.1%，上下文可达 86K 到 123K tokens，甚至到百万字符级。正确性侧，作者覆盖 17 个 tokenizer families，使用 version-pinned artifacts；差分测试包括 synthetic/adversarial inputs、12.4TB real-text corpus 全量 sweep，以及 93,000+ replayed agent steps，测试配置中没有发现与 reference tokenizer 的 divergence。性能侧，incremental repair 在 100K 到 3M characters 范围内保持 0.5–1.1ms；在 1M characters 上比最强 cache-based alternative 快 2.1×，在 2M 上快 3.0×。full-context GPU path 达到 3.8–4.7GB/s，1M-character context 编码耗时 0.87ms，比文中对比的最快已发表 CPU 方法低 23.4×。接入 vLLM 后，在 loaded regimes 下 median TTFT 降低 16–34%，在记录的 burst arrivals 下 P99 降低 23%。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 workload measurement 和 component sweep，那里解释了为什么 tokenizer 会在高 cache hit 场景下变成瓶颈。然后看 tokenization non-compositionality 的例子和 stable boundary check，这是论文最关键的正确性设计。GPU tokenizer 部分适合关注 GPT-family regex 如何被 run decomposition 等价改写；这部分对设计新 tokenizer 或评估 tokenizer serving 成本有参考意义。实验部分重点看 differential testing 覆盖范围、增量 repair 延迟曲线、vLLM end-to-end TTFT 结果。可以跳过部分工程实现细节，除非正在做 serving 前端或 tokenizer runtime。

summary_en.core_problem: TokTier addresses a front-end bottleneck in agentic LLM serving. Prefix KV caching lets the model reuse the unchanged prompt state, but the serving front end often re-tokenizes the entire transcript for every call. Coding agents make this expensive: most calls append a small tool result to a long session history. Reusing previous token IDs is not trivial because tokenization is not compositional; a short append can change token boundaries near the end of the previous text.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly in serving systems rather than pretraining, but it is relevant to base-model researchers who care about long-context and agent workloads. The paper shows that when prompt-cache hit rate approaches 0.99, tokenization can grow from 10% to 64% of time-to-first-token in component measurements. It also gives a useful reminder: tokenizer behavior is part of the model interface. Approximate token reuse, fixed-overlap heuristics, or non-equivalent GPU tokenizers can change input IDs and silently invalidate prefix-cache keys.
summary_en.technical_approach: TokTier uses two execution paths under an exactness contract: every emitted token sequence must match a frozen reference tokenizer on the full request text. For session continuations, it stores token IDs and byte spans for each live session. On append, it re-tokenizes the new text plus a suffix of the old context, compares fresh and cached token records, and splices only after a stable-boundary check proves that the pre-tokenizer cannot observe across the boundary. If the check fails, TokTier widens the repair window and eventually falls back to full reference tokenization. For calls without a reusable prefix, it implements an exact GPU path for GPT-family tokenizers. The sequential regex stage is replaced by a run decomposition over maximal character-class runs; piece starts are derived from run position, bounded neighboring text, and run-level summaries. A GPU BPE pipeline then encodes the pieces. Short inputs remain on CPU, tokenizer artifacts are content-addressed, and a background verifier samples live requests and compares against the reference implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The workload analysis covers 153,951 calls from two agent ecosystems. The median call appends about 1.4K characters, while only 1.0–3.6% of calls start or rebuild a session. The fleet-level prompt-cache hit rate is 94.1%, and typical contexts are reported around 86K to 123K tokens, with some full contexts reaching millions of characters. For correctness, the evaluation covers 17 tokenizer families with pinned artifacts, synthetic and adversarial inputs, a full sweep over a 12.4TB real-text corpus, and more than 93,000 replayed agent steps, with no reported divergence from the reference. For performance, incremental repair stays at 0.5–1.1ms from 100K to 3M characters. It is 2.1× faster than the strongest cache-based alternative at 1M characters and 3.0× faster at 2M. The GPU full-context path sustains 3.8–4.7GB/s and tokenizes a 1M-character context in 0.87ms, 23.4× below the fastest previously published CPU method in their comparison. Integrated with vLLM, TokTier reduces median TTFT by 16–34% under loaded regimes and P99 by 23% under recorded burst arrivals.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 20–30 minutes. Start with the workload measurements and the TTFT component sweep; they justify why tokenization matters once KV-cache reuse is high. Then read the non-compositional tokenization examples and the stable-boundary check, which are the core correctness mechanisms. The GPU tokenizer section is useful if you care about tokenizer design or serving-time tokenizer cost, especially the exact reformulation of GPT-style regex pre-tokenization. In the evaluation, focus on the differential-testing setup, the repair-latency curves, and the vLLM end-to-end TTFT results.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但它把一个常被忽略的 serving 真瓶颈讲清楚了；只看 exactness contract 和 stable-boundary 机制，足够启发 tokenizer/serving 接口设计。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly exposes a real serving bottleneck people usually hand-wave away; read the exactness contract and stable-boundary mechanism, then move on.

paper.title: Language Models are not Equally Robust to Non-Canonical Tokenization across Languages
paper.abstract: Despite the existence of exponentially many valid tokenizations for a given string, language models operate on a single canonical sequence deterministically produced by the tokenizer, leaving the broader tokenization space largely uncharacterized. In this paper, we investigate this overlooked space by studying the behavior of language models under non-canonical tokenizations across diverse languages. For English, prior work shows that models are largely invariant to alternative tokenizations tha

summary.core_problem: 系统刻画“非规范（non-canonical）tokenization”对多语种 LLM 的影响：同一字符串存在大量等价的合法分词序列，但模型只在规范分词上预训练。问题是：这种分词扰动下的鲁棒性是否像英文那样近似不变？如果不成立，哪些语言/脚本/任务会显著退化，退化机制是什么？
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练研究的影响很直接：tokenizer 不再只是“词表大小/覆盖率”的工程选择，而是决定了模型对输入表示扰动的稳定性边界。论文给出一个清晰结论：英文观察到的 tokenization invariance 不能外推到多语种；鲁棒性是一个独立属性，与模型强弱不简单等价，并与语言的 token fragmentation（同一句话被切得多碎）强相关。对实际系统也有现实意义：词表裁剪/重分配、跨语种 tokenizer 迁移、甚至安全绕过，都可能让线上输入落到非规范分词分布上。更进一步，作者把非规范分词当作一种“自然的数据增强”，提示可以在预训练或 mid-train 中显式训练分词不变性。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 形式化：
- 定义字符串 x 的所有合法 tokenization 集合 T(x)，其中包含规范分词 T_canon(x)。
- 定义 tokenization invariance：对任意 t1,t2∈T(x)，模型输出/行为应一致；并用某种距离 d 度量偏离程度（性能差距或表示差异）。

2) 构造非规范分词：
- 在不改变 decode 后字符串的前提下，生成替代分词序列（全部由词表中合法 token 组成）。这类输入严格保持表面文本不变，因此把变量集中在“分词序列分布偏移”。

3) 评测设计：
- 27 种语言、覆盖不同脚本与语言家族；6 类下游任务；3 个近期模型家族。
- 不只看生成任务，还覆盖依赖句向量的语义任务（例如跨语种句子检索），用来证明影响不仅是解码层面的“输出不流畅”，而是表示学习本身会变。

4) 机制分析假设：
- 关键解释变量是 token fragmentation：同样的字符串在某些语言上被切成更多、更短、更稀有的 token，导致非规范分词更容易把输入推到训练分布外；同时序列更长也会改变注意力路径与位置分布，从而放大差异。

5) 训练启示：
- 把非规范分词作为数据增强：在训练中对同一字符串采样多种合法分词，逼近分词不变性。与“换 tokenizer 重新预训练”相比，这条路更像在固定词表下做鲁棒性训练，成本更低，也更贴近 tokenizer 迁移/裁剪后的真实线上扰动。
summary.experiments:
全文片段未包含主表数字与具体模型名称/版本号，因此无法安全复述具体提升/下降幅度。但从作者在引言中的明确陈述可提炼出几条“实验结论级”信息：
- 多语种 LLM 在非规范分词下的鲁棒性差异很大，且随语言/任务/模型家族变化。
- 鲁棒性不是“模型越强越鲁棒”的单调函数，而是受语言侧 tokenization 特性显著影响。
- 影响扩展到句向量/检索等语义任务，说明 tokenization 扰动会改变表示空间。
- 非规范分词可作为数据增强，能提升多语种泛化。
建议阅读时把注意力放在：按语言分组的退化幅度、与 fragmentation 指标的相关性图、以及数据增强带来的增益是否在多任务上稳定。
summary.reading_guide:
精读建议（这篇属于 must_read）：
- 先读 Methodology 的形式化定义与 non-canonical tokenization 的生成方式：这是后续所有结论的“实验操作定义”。
- 重点看按语言/脚本分组的主结果图表：哪些语言最脆弱、哪些相对稳定，是否与词表分配不均一致。
- 找到与 token fragmentation 相关的分析：它是论文的核心解释变量，决定结论能否迁移到 tokenizer 设计与数据配比决策。
- 认真看“非规范分词作为数据增强”的实验：增强策略怎么采样、训练开销多少、对哪些语言收益最大、是否牺牲英文或高资源语言。
- 最后看语义任务（跨语种检索/embedding）部分：它能帮助判断问题是“解码鲁棒性”还是“表征鲁棒性”。
预计精读 1.5–2.5 小时（含回看图表与附录设置）。

summary_en.core_problem: Characterizing how multilingual LLMs behave under non-canonical tokenizations: the same string admits many valid segmentations, but models are pretrained almost exclusively on the canonical one. The question is whether the English-level invariance to alternative tokenizations holds across languages, and if not, which languages/scripts/tasks break and why.
summary_en.importance: This is directly relevant to pretraining and tokenizer design. The paper shows that tokenization robustness is not a universal property you can infer from English, nor a simple monotonic function of model strength. It is strongly shaped by language-specific tokenization characteristics (notably token fragmentation). Practically, this matters whenever tokenization changes after pretraining—vocabulary pruning/reallocation, tokenizer transfer to new languages/domains, or adversarial tokenizations that preserve surface text. The additional takeaway is actionable: sampling non-canonical tokenizations can serve as a natural augmentation to improve multilingual generalization, suggesting a path to train tokenization invariance without fully re-pretraining with a new tokenizer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Formalization:
- Define the set of valid tokenizations T(x) for a string x, including the canonical tokenization T_canon(x).
- Define tokenization invariance as identical model behavior for any t1,t2∈T(x), and quantify deviation via a distance d (performance gap or representation difference).

2) Non-canonical tokenization generation:
- Construct alternative token sequences composed of valid vocabulary tokens that decode to the exact same surface string, isolating distribution shift purely in token segmentation.

3) Evaluation protocol:
- A multilingual sweep over 27 languages spanning diverse scripts, 6 downstream tasks, and 3 recent model families.
- Importantly includes non-generation semantic tasks (e.g., cross-lingual sentence retrieval using embeddings), to test whether the effect is representational rather than just decoding fluency.

4) Mechanistic analysis:
- Emphasizes token fragmentation as a key explanatory factor: languages that are more fragmented under a shared multilingual vocabulary are more exposed to out-of-distribution segmentations; longer sequences and rarer subpieces can amplify sensitivity.

5) Training implication:
- Treat non-canonical tokenizations as augmentation: sample multiple valid segmentations for the same string during training to encourage invariance. Compared to swapping tokenizers and re-pretraining, this is a lower-cost robustness intervention that matches real-world tokenizer adaptation scenarios.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided excerpt does not include the main quantitative tables/figures or exact model variants, so it’s not safe to quote numbers. The paper’s experimentally stated conclusions are:
- Robustness to non-canonical tokenization varies sharply by language, task, and model family.
- Robustness is not simply explained by “stronger model = more robust”.
- Effects extend to embedding-based semantic tasks (e.g., cross-lingual retrieval), indicating representation shifts.
- Non-canonical tokenization can be used as augmentation to improve multilingual generalization.
When reading, prioritize: per-language degradation plots, correlations with fragmentation metrics, and the stability/consistency of augmentation gains across tasks and languages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Must-read deep dive (1.5–2.5 hours):
- Start with the Methodology section: the formal definition of valid tokenizations and how non-canonical tokenizations are generated is the experimental backbone.
- Study the main results grouped by language/script: identify the most fragile languages and whether patterns align with vocabulary allocation and fragmentation.
- Focus on the fragmentation analysis: it’s the central explanatory variable that connects findings back to tokenizer construction and data mixture decisions.
- Read the augmentation section carefully: sampling strategy, training cost, which languages benefit most, and whether there are trade-offs for English/high-resource languages.
- Pay special attention to embedding/retrieval tasks: they help distinguish “generation robustness” from “representation robustness”.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻把非 canonical tokenization 加进 tokenizer 回归测试；英文不变性这个 prior 在多语言上不可靠。
recommendation.en: Add non-canonical tokenization to tokenizer regression tests; the English invariance prior does not survive multilingual evaluation.

paper.title: TopoGR: Revealing and Preserving Latent Structure of Semantic ID in Generative Recommendation
paper.abstract: Semantic ID-based generative recommendation tokenizes each item into a sequence of discrete semantic IDs and predicts the next item by generating semantic IDs. However, existing methods typically regard SIDs as independent discrete symbols, while often overlooking the topology of the learned semantic ID space.
