We identify a structural mismatch between tokenization and generation: the tokenizer learns a structured code space with semantic neighborhood relations, whereas the generator consumes sem

summary.core_problem: 生成式推荐中，语义ID tokenizer学到的带语义邻接关系的结构化码空间，与生成器将token视为独立分类符号的处理方式存在结构失配，导致语义相似但ID不重叠的item无法被识别。
summary.importance: 明确指出tokenization与生成阶段的通用结构失配问题，提出位分解二进制SID保留语义拓扑，在生成式推荐任务上取得性能提升。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Bit-decomposable Semantic ID（Binary SID），将每个item的SID按位分解，可确定性转换为标准整数SID，同时向生成器暴露bit级语义拓扑，缓解结构失配问题。
summary.experiments: 在四个真实世界推荐数据集上验证，相比现有强生成式推荐基线取得稳定性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: In generative recommendation, a structural mismatch exists between the structured code space with semantic neighborhood relations learned by the semantic ID tokenizer, and the generator's treatment of tokens as independent categorical symbols, leading to failure in identifying semantically similar items with non-overlapping IDs.
summary_en.importance: Explicitly identifies the general structural mismatch problem between tokenization and generation stages, proposes bit-decomposed binary SIDs to preserve semantic topology, and achieves performance gains on generative recommendation tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Bit-decomposable Semantic ID (Binary SID), which decomposes each item's SID into bits, can be deterministically converted to standard integer SIDs, and exposes bit-level semantic topology to the generator to mitigate the structural mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on four real-world recommendation datasets, showing consistent performance improvements over strong generative recommendation baselines.

recommendation.zh: 指出tokenizer结构化码空间与生成器独立符号假设的失配问题，对LLM tokenizer设计有参考，推荐专属方法无需深究。
recommendation.en: Identifies the mismatch between tokenizer structured code space and generator's independent token assumption; useful reference for LLM tokenizer design, skip recommendation-specific methods.

paper.title: Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-match Tokenization
paper.abstract: Recent work has shown that subword vocabularies can be trained to optimize compression for a specific inference rule rather than relying on greedy heuristics such as Byte Pair Encoding (BPE). We extend this approach to greedy left-to-right longest-match decoding, the fast and widely used inference rule underlying WordPiece. We introduce Joint Optimization for Greedy Longest-Match Tokenization (JOLT), which formulates vocabulary learning as an integer program over vocabulary-selection and segment

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个很具体但长期被启发式方法主导的问题：当部署时采用 WordPiece 常见的 greedy left-to-right longest-match（GL2R）解码规则时，怎样直接为这个推理规则学习词表，而不是像 BPE 那样先用贪心 merge 过程构造词表，再把它拿去给另一套推理规则使用。难点不在“压缩目标”本身，而在“词表选择”和“分词可实现性”是耦合的：某个切分方案只有在不存在更长 token 抢占边界时，才真能被 GL2R 解码复现。论文要解决的核心，就是把这种 greedy 一致性精确写进优化问题里，使训练时优化的 token 数与部署时真实产生的 token 数一致。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两层。第一层是 tokenizer 设计范式：词表训练不必绑定某个历史启发式，而应当围绕部署时的 inference rule 直接建模。JOLT 把“tokenizer 训练目标”和“tokenizer 推理规则”对齐，这一点对后续研究很重要。第二层是负结果同样有价值：在 GL2R 这个广泛使用的规则下，BPE 在训练集上的 token count 已经离 LP 下界只有 1%–2% 左右，JOLT 虽然能系统性改进，但 held-out 压缩提升最多只有 0.78%。这说明在固定 byte-level、固定词表规模、固定贪心最长匹配规则的设定下，单靠更强的词表优化，剩余空间并不大。对做大模型预训练的人来说，这个结论比单纯“又快了 0.x%”更重要，因为它帮助判断 tokenizer 研究的边际收益在哪里。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，JOLT 延续了 ToaST 和 ConvexTok 的“整数规划 → 线性松弛 → rounding”路线，但关键区别是它不是为 split-tree 或 shortest-path 推理设计，而是专门为 GL2R 设计约束。建模对象有两类变量：一类表示候选 token 是否进入词表，另一类表示每个 pretoken 选用哪一种候选 segmentation。目标函数是最小化按频次加权的总 token 数，也就是压缩目标。真正的技术核心在 greedy-consistency constraints：如果某个 pretoken 选择了一个 segmentation，那么在每个 segment 起点处，不能存在一个更长、且同样匹配该位置字节串的已选 token，否则 GL2R 实际会优先输出那个更长 token，训练时选的 segmentation 就不可实现。这个约束把“分词方案”和“词表内容”紧密耦合起来。

另一个关键点是规模控制。因为一个长度为 n 的 pretoken 有 2^(n-1) 种切分，不能全部显式枚举。JOLT 采用按需生成候选 segmentation 的做法，先只保留少量低阶切分，再在求解过程中逐步加入需要的候选，避免组合爆炸。训练语料先按 regex 切成 pretoken，并聚合相同 pretokens 的频次；实际优化只保留 top-N 高频 pretokens。求解时先做 LP relaxation，再通过 rounding 得到固定大小词表。论文强调 rounding 不是主要误差来源，因为最终离 LP bound 很近。和 BPE 相比，JOLT 不再依赖局部 merge 频次；和 UnigramLM 相比，它不是概率生成式分词；和 ConvexTok/ToaST 相比，它的可行性条件是由 GL2R 的最长匹配机制决定的，而不是最短路或树结构推理。
summary.experiments:
实验重点不是下游任务，而是压缩质量、LP 下界诊断和 rounding 损失。作者在四个训练 scope 上评估，N 取 100k、200k、300k、400k 高频 pretokens。结果是：在相同词表规模下，JOLT 在 held-out 文本上的 greedy-L2R token count 相对 BPE 最多下降 0.78%，而且更大的训练 scope 一般带来持平或更好的压缩。更有信息量的是下界分析：BPE 在训练 scope 上距离 LP lower bound 只有 1%–2%，说明 BPE 在 GL2R 设定下已经相当接近最优；JOLT 能弥合其中 89.6%–99.4% 的 gap；rounding 后的离散词表距离 LP bound 仅 0.008%–0.176%，几乎没有额外损失。这个结果直接支持作者的判断：JOLT 相对 BPE 的提升小，不是因为 rounding 做坏了，而是因为理论可提升空间本来就不大。

如果从预训练角度读实验，还应注意两点。第一，论文讨论的是 token count compression，而不是 LM perplexity 或下游精度，因此不能自动推出“训练更好”；它更像是在给 tokenizer 设计空间做上界测量。第二，作者使用 byte-level 设定并保留单字节 token，因此不存在 OOV 问题，实验结论主要反映“在这个基础设定下，GL2R 词表优化的纯压缩上限”。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时建议先看 Introduction 和方法总览，抓住一句话：JOLT 的价值不只是多压缩一点，而是把 GL2R 的真实解码约束写进优化目标。然后重点看定义 greedy-consistency 的部分，这里是全文最值得读的地方；如果这个约束没看明白，整篇论文会显得只是“又一个 LP tokenizer”。接着看实验里关于 LP lower bound、BPE gap、rounding gap 的表和图，这些结果比 headline 提升更有判断价值。附录里如果给了 separation / column generation / rounding 细节，也值得快速扫一遍，因为这决定方法是否能扩到更大语料。

预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。若只想判断是否值得继续深挖，看三件事就够：GL2R 可实现性约束怎么写；BPE 离下界到底多近；JOLT 的收益是否主要来自更大训练 scope 而非更复杂 rounding。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a precise tokenizer-design problem: how to learn a vocabulary that is directly optimized for greedy left-to-right longest-match decoding (GL2R), the inference rule commonly associated with WordPiece, instead of training a vocabulary with a heuristic such as BPE and only later decoding with GL2R. The hard part is not compression alone. Under GL2R, a segmentation is valid only if no longer selected token can preempt any segment boundary. So vocabulary selection and segmentation choice are coupled. The paper’s central contribution is to encode this coupling exactly, so the optimization objective matches the token count realized at deployment.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the main value is conceptual. It reinforces that tokenizer training should be aligned with the actual inference rule, rather than inherited from historical heuristics. JOLT is a clean example of inference-aware tokenizer optimization. The second contribution is diagnostic rather than purely incremental: under byte-level tokenization, fixed vocabulary size, and GL2R decoding, BPE is already within roughly 1%–2% of the LP lower bound on the training scope. JOLT improves on BPE consistently, but the held-out gain tops out at 0.78%. That is a useful boundary result. It suggests that, in this regime, better vocabulary optimization alone has limited remaining headroom. For people working on foundation-model pretraining, that matters more than the raw compression delta.
summary_en.technical_approach:
JOLT follows the same high-level recipe as ToaST and ConvexTok—integer programming, LP relaxation, then rounding—but the formulation is specific to GL2R rather than split-tree or shortest-path inference. The model has two coupled sets of variables: token-selection variables indicating which candidate substrings enter the vocabulary, and segmentation-choice variables indicating which candidate segmentation is chosen for each pretoken. The objective minimizes frequency-weighted total token count.

The technical core is the greedy-consistency constraint. If a pretoken is assigned a particular segmentation, then at every segment start there must not exist a longer selected token that also matches the bytes at that position; otherwise GL2R would emit the longer token and the chosen segmentation would not be realizable. This is the mechanism that ties segmentation feasibility to vocabulary content.

A second important piece is scalability. A pretoken of length n has 2^(n-1) possible segmentations, so full enumeration is impossible. JOLT therefore works with a restricted candidate set and adds segmentations on demand, based on the optimization state, instead of instantiating the full combinatorial space. The corpus is first split into pretokens with a regex and aggregated by count; optimization is then run on the top-N most frequent pretokens. The LP solution is rounded to a fixed-size vocabulary, and the paper argues that rounding is not the main source of suboptimality because the rounded solutions stay extremely close to the LP bound. Relative to BPE, JOLT removes the dependence on local merge heuristics. Relative to UnigramLM, it is not a probabilistic latent-segmentation model. Relative to ConvexTok and ToaST, the feasibility constraints are driven by GL2R longest-match behavior.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments focus on compression, LP-bound diagnostics, and rounding loss rather than downstream language-model quality. The authors evaluate four training scopes with N in {100k, 200k, 300k, 400k} high-frequency pretokens. At equal vocabulary size, JOLT reduces held-out greedy-L2R token count by up to 0.78% relative to BPE, and larger scopes are consistently as good or better.

The more informative result is the lower-bound analysis. On the training scope, BPE is already only about 1%–2% above the LP lower bound, indicating that BPE is near-optimal for GL2R in this setting. JOLT closes 89.6%–99.4% of that gap, and the rounded vocabularies end up only 0.008%–0.176% above the LP bound. So the small margin over BPE is not a rounding artifact; it reflects genuinely limited headroom.

From a pretraining perspective, two caveats matter. First, the paper studies token-count compression, not LM perplexity or downstream accuracy, so the results should not be read as direct evidence of better model quality. Second, the setup is byte-level with single-byte fallback tokens, so there is no OOV issue; the conclusions are specifically about the compression ceiling of GL2R-aware vocabulary optimization under that regime.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the problem setup. The key idea to retain is simple: JOLT matters because it optimizes for the actual GL2R decoding rule, not because it beats BPE by a large margin. Then go directly to the section defining the greedy-consistency constraints. That is the part worth understanding in detail; without it, the paper can look like just another LP tokenizer paper. After that, read the experimental tables and figures on the LP lower bound, the BPE gap, and the rounding gap. Those diagnostics are more informative than the headline compression gain.

If the appendix includes the separation procedure, candidate-generation details, or rounding algorithm, it is worth skimming because those details determine whether the method can scale beyond the reported setup. Expected reading time: about 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和近整数性实验即可；若内部还在用 WordPiece/BPE heuristic，JOLT 是值得复现的小型 tokenizer ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the method and near-integrality results; if your stack still relies on WordPiece/BPE heuristics, JOLT is a clean tokenizer ablation to reproduce.

institutions: Center for Data Science, New York University

paper.title: Rate-Utility Frontiers for Language Encodings: Comparing Tokens, Bytes, and Pixels Under Controlled Linguistic Content
paper.abstract: Language models encode text as subword tokens, raw bytes, or rendered pixels, but these encodings are usually compared under modeling constraints that expose different amounts of linguistic content to models across different languages. We instead ask what each encoding preserves when both the content and the downstream capacity are controlled. Using verified parallel sentences across thirteen languages and five scripts, we compare tokens, bytes, and pixels through a shared bottleneck whose width

summary.core_problem: 在“语言内容相同、下游容量相同”的前提下，比较不同文本编码（subword tokens / raw bytes / rendered pixels）各自保留了哪些对任务有用的信息，并用 rate–utility frontier 把常被混在一起的三件事拆开：输入位置数（source rate）、编码后可用的潜在容量（bottleneck width）、以及压缩后仍存活的任务相关信息（utility）。
summary.importance: 对预训练与 tokenizer 研究的启发点在于：很多关于“token vs byte vs pixel”的结论其实被“不同语言/脚本下暴露给模型的内容量不同”以及“模型容量/序列长度预算不同”污染了。本文用并行语料 + 共享瓶颈把比较条件钉死，给出更可解释的结论：短序列不等于信息保留更好；长序列也可能因为结构可压缩而更划算。它为多语种 tokenizer 设计、byte-level 方案、以及把文本当视觉输入的路线提供了一个更公平的评估框架（尤其适合讨论跨脚本公平性与预算分配）。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 内容控制：使用 SIB-200 人工翻译并行句子，保证 13 种语言/5 种脚本下语义内容一致，并共享同一 topic label。
2) 容量控制：所有编码都通过同一个“共享瓶颈”（固定宽度的潜在表示），并扫 bottleneck width 得到 rate–utility frontier。这样比较的是“在同等下游容量下，编码能保住多少有用信息”，而不是谁更短。
3) 重新训练 tokenizer：为匹配内容与语言制度，作者在对应语言 regime 上重训 tokenizers，避免 token baseline 因为词表覆盖不匹配而吃亏/占便宜。
4) 三类 utility 探针：
- Form preservation：能否恢复表面字符串（更偏向字符级/排版信息）。
- Cross-lingual retrieval：翻译句子在表示空间是否对齐（更偏向跨语言等价性）。
- Topic classification：压缩表示是否保留足够语义用于下游分类（更偏向语义抽象）。
5) 多种语言制度（regimes）：单语（English/Chinese）、同脚本多语（Latin-5、Cyrillic-5）、多脚本多语（Multiscript-5），用来分离“语言数增加”和“脚本多样性增加”的影响。
summary.experiments:
数据与设置：SIB-200 标准划分，每语言 701/99/204（train/val/test）句。
主要发现（以 frontier 形式呈现，而非单点）：
- utility 不跟 source rate 简单单调：编码更短不代表在固定瓶颈下更好。
- 任务依赖的偏好：pixels 更擅长保留 surface form；bytes 在跨语对齐/检索上更稳；tokens 在 topic prediction 上更占优。
- 脚本与语言的交互：在 multiscript 情况下，跨脚本对齐更难；中文的表意特性使得在 topic 预测上不同编码差距变小，但在跨脚本对齐（尤其 pixels）上仍可能更困难。
（你提供的正文片段未包含完整数值表与曲线坐标；论文的贡献点主要在实验控制与 frontier 形状，而非某个单一指标的百分点。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议 30–45 分钟：
- 先看方法总览图与“source rate / bottleneck / utility”三分法的定义，这决定了它和以往 tokenization 对比工作的差异。
- 精看实验设置：SIB-200 并行控制、五种语言 regime、tokenizer 重训细节、瓶颈如何实现（是线性投影、VQ、还是别的压缩模块）。
- 重点看三类 probe 的实现：form recovery 的评价方式、cross-lingual retrieval 的相似度/检索协议、topic head 的训练方式；这些细节决定 utility 的含义。
- 最后看 frontier 曲线：在不同 bottleneck 宽度下三种编码的相对排序何时翻转，以及 compute 代价如何随编码变化。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide a controlled comparison of text encodings—subword tokens, raw bytes, and rendered pixels—by holding linguistic content constant and holding downstream capacity constant, then measuring what task-relevant information survives compression via rate–utility frontiers.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining/tokenizer research, the key contribution is methodological: many encoding comparisons are confounded by (a) different amounts of content exposed under fixed sequence/compute budgets across languages and scripts, and (b) different effective downstream capacity. By using parallel sentences and a shared bottleneck, the paper isolates what each encoding preserves under equal capacity. The results caution against equating “shorter sequences” with “better representations,” and offer a cleaner lens for multilingual fairness, byte-level modeling tradeoffs, and text-as-vision approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Content control: use SIB-200, a human-translated parallel dataset where each sentence exists in every language with the same topic label.
2) Capacity control: pass each encoding through the same bottleneck module and sweep bottleneck width to trace rate–utility frontiers.
3) Token baseline fairness: retrain tokenizers on matched content for each language regime so the token condition is not advantaged/disadvantaged by mismatched vocabulary coverage.
4) Utilities (probes): (i) surface form preservation (recover the written sentence), (ii) cross-lingual retrieval (translations should be close in representation space), (iii) topic classification (semantic utility under compression).
5) Language/script regimes: monolingual (English, Chinese), multilingual same-script (Latin-5, Cyrillic-5), and multilingual multi-script (Multiscript-5) to disentangle language count vs script diversity effects.
summary_en.experiments:
Setup: SIB-200 standard splits with 701/99/204 train/val/test sentences per language.
Main empirical takeaways (reported as frontiers rather than single operating points):
- Utility does not track source rate monotonically; shorter encodings can misallocate capacity, while longer encodings may preserve structure that compresses well.
- Encoding preference is task- and capacity-dependent: pixels best preserve surface form; bytes are most reliable for cross-lingual alignment/retrieval; tokens are strongest for topic prediction.
- Script effects matter: multi-script settings degrade alignment (especially for pixels); Chinese’s logographic properties narrow gaps for topic prediction but do not eliminate cross-script alignment difficulty.
(The provided excerpt does not include the full numeric tables/plots; the paper’s emphasis is on controlled comparisons and frontier shapes.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in ~30–45 minutes:
- Read the definitions of source rate, bottleneck capacity, and utility; this is the conceptual core.
- Check the experimental controls: parallel data construction, tokenizer retraining protocol, and the exact bottleneck implementation.
- Inspect how each probe is operationalized (metrics and training protocol), since that determines what “utility” means.
- Spend time on the frontier plots: look for regime changes where the preferred encoding flips as bottleneck width changes, and note any compute-cost annotations.

recommendation.zh: 读 rate-utility 设计和结论表即可；它提醒 tokenizer 比较必须控制内容量和 bottleneck。
recommendation.en: Read the rate-utility setup and result table; it is a useful reminder that tokenizer comparisons must control content and bottleneck capacity.

paper.title: Discrete Diffusion Models: A Unified Framework from Tokenization to Generation
paper.abstract: Discrete denoising diffusion models (DDMs) have recently emerged as a compelling alternative to autoregressive (AR) modeling for discrete data, offering parallel generation and iterative global refinement capabilities. Unlike continuous diffusion, where the state space is fixed, DDMs are fundamentally shaped by how the discrete state space is constructed: the tokenization scheme, the vocabulary topology, and domain-specific structural alphabets. This work introduces a unified conceptual framewor

summary.core_problem: 这项工作试图统一 discrete diffusion model 的设计空间。核心问题不是某一个 denoising loss，而是离散状态空间如何被构造：文本 tokenizer、VQ codebook、音频 codec token、蛋白质或分子 alphabet，都会改变 corruption process、reverse denoiser、采样顺序、有效上下文和生成质量。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究的影响在于，它把 diffusion LM 从“AR 的替代解码方式”推进到“tokenization + state-space + denoising dynamics”的整体问题。对文本 LLM，启发点是 tokenizer 不只是压缩率和 OOV 问题，还决定 mask 粒度、替换噪声语义、序列长度和可学习的 denoising 难度。对多模态统一预训练，启发更直接：图像、音频、视频如果通过 VQ-VAE、residual quantizer 或 codec 离散化，codebook 拓扑会影响 diffusion 的噪声路径；忽略这种拓扑，相当于把所有 token 错误都视作等价。贡献类型偏框架和综述，但主题处在 AR、masked LM、D3PM、SEDD、MDLM、LLaDA 以及 tokenized multimodal LM 的交界处，适合基座研究员精读。
summary.technical_approach: 统一视角是把 discrete diffusion 看成在离散状态空间上的 corruption-denoising 系统。状态空间由 tokenization 决定，可以是 BPE/subword token、字符或 byte、VQ 图像 token、codec audio token、video token，也可以是氨基酸、核苷酸、原子和键类型等自然 alphabet。在这个视角下，已有方法可被放进同一设计空间。D3PM 类方法显式定义 categorical transition matrix，允许 uniform、nearest-neighbor 或结构感知替换。Masking/absorbing-state 方法把 mask token 作为吸收态，训练模型从部分损坏序列恢复 clean token；这与 masked LM 接近，但采样是多步迭代而不是一次性填空。Score-或 ratio-based 方法不直接预测连续 score，而是在离散状态上学习概率比或去噪方向，代表路线包括 SEDD、MDLM、LLaDA 这类离散扩散/流匹配语言模型。相比 embed-then-diffuse，native discrete diffusion 避免在 embedding 空间加高斯噪声再 rounding 的几何错配。相比 AR，它牺牲了简单的 left-to-right likelihood 和成熟 decoding 栈，换来并行更新、全局修订、infilling/editing 的自然接口，以及非左到右生成顺序。
summary.experiments: 这项工作以统一框架和文献归纳为主，不以新的大规模训练实验为核心。正文介绍的证据来自不同离散扩散路线和应用族的比较：文本与代码 diffusion LM、tokenized multimodal generation、科学序列和结构化 alphabet。关键实验性结论更像设计规律。第一，token 粒度会改变 denoising 难度：subword token 缩短序列但单 token 语义更粗，byte/char 增加长度但状态更规则。第二，vocabulary topology 会决定替换噪声是否合理：图像或音频 codebook 中相近 token 如果被 uniform corruption 随机打散，denoiser 学到的局部结构会更困难。第三，absorbing mask 适合文本 infilling 和任意顺序生成，但可能带来训练-采样 mismatch，需要设计 remasking、confidence schedule 或 step allocation。第四，离散 diffusion 的并行性不等于免费加速；采样步数、denoiser 规模、重采样策略和长序列并行效率共同决定实际 latency。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读三部分。第一，看 tokenization/state-space 的框架定义，重点是它如何把文本 tokenizer、多模态 codebook 和科学 alphabet 放到同一语言里。第二，看 transition-matrix、masking/absorbing-state、score/ratio-based 三类方法的对应关系；这里能看清 D3PM、masked diffusion、SEDD/MDLM/LLaDA 的差别。第三，看 generation 部分，尤其是并行 denoising、iterative refinement、confidence-based remasking、infilling/editing 的采样机制。做 LLM 预训练的人可以重点追问三个问题：现有 BPE 是否适合 diffusion LM；是否需要为 diffusion 重新设计 tokenizer；多模态 codebook 的距离结构能否进入 corruption matrix 或 noise schedule。预计精读需要 1.5 到 2 小时。

summary_en.core_problem: The work organizes discrete diffusion models around the construction of the discrete state space. The central question is not only which denoising loss to use, but how tokenization, vocabulary topology, and domain-specific alphabets shape the corruption process, the reverse model, the sampling order, and the attainable generation behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its value for foundation-model pretraining is the shift from viewing diffusion language models as merely non-autoregressive decoders to viewing them as a joint design problem over tokenization, state-space geometry, and denoising dynamics. For text, the tokenizer determines mask granularity, replacement semantics, effective sequence length, and denoising difficulty. For unified multimodal modeling, the point is even sharper: image, audio, and video tokens produced by VQ models, residual quantizers, or codecs have codebook structure, and a corruption process that ignores this structure treats all substitutions as equally meaningful. The contribution is mainly conceptual and taxonomic, but it sits directly at the interface of D3PM, masked diffusion, SEDD, MDLM, LLaDA, and tokenized multimodal language modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework treats a discrete diffusion model as a corruption-denoising system over a constructed state space. That state space may come from BPE or subword tokenizers, bytes or characters, VQ image tokens, codec audio tokens, video tokens, or natural scientific alphabets such as amino acids, nucleotides, atom types, and bond types. Within this lens, several families become different choices in the same design space. Transition-matrix methods, as in D3PM-style models, specify categorical transitions directly and can support uniform, nearest-neighbor, or structure-aware corruption. Masking or absorbing-state methods introduce a mask token as an absorbing state and train the model to recover clean tokens from partially corrupted sequences; they are related to masked language modeling, but generation proceeds through iterative denoising rather than one-shot filling. Score- or ratio-based methods learn discrete probability ratios or denoising directions rather than continuous scores, covering recent diffusion and flow-matching language models such as SEDD, MDLM, and LLaDA-like systems. The framework also explains why embed-then-diffuse is fragile: adding Gaussian noise in embedding space and rounding back to tokens creates a mismatch between continuous geometry and discrete vocabulary structure. Compared with AR modeling, native discrete diffusion gives up the simplicity of left-to-right likelihood and mature decoding infrastructure, but gains parallel updates, global revision, and a natural interface for infilling and editing.
summary_en.experiments: The work is primarily a unifying framework rather than a new large-scale empirical training study. Its evidence is comparative and organizational, spanning diffusion language models for text and code, tokenized multimodal generation, and scientific sequences or structured alphabets. Several practical lessons are emphasized. Token granularity changes the denoising problem: subword tokenization shortens sequences but makes each token semantically larger, while byte or character tokenization increases length but regularizes the alphabet. Vocabulary topology matters: in image or audio codebooks, uniform corruption can destroy local structure that a topology-aware transition matrix could preserve. Absorbing-mask models are convenient for infilling and arbitrary-order generation, but they require careful sampling schedules, confidence-based remasking, or step allocation to reduce train-sample mismatch. Parallel generation is not automatically faster in wall-clock terms; the number of denoising steps, denoiser size, resampling policy, and hardware efficiency determine the realized latency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the state-space and tokenization framework first. It is the part that connects text tokenizers, multimodal codebooks, and scientific alphabets under one set of modeling choices. Then focus on the comparison among transition-matrix, masking or absorbing-state, and score or ratio-based formulations; this is where the differences between D3PM-style models, masked diffusion, SEDD, MDLM, and LLaDA-like approaches become clear. Finally, read the generation discussion for iterative refinement, parallel denoising, confidence-based remasking, and infilling or editing. For LLM pretraining, the most useful questions are whether BPE is a good tokenizer for diffusion LMs, whether diffusion requires a tokenizer designed around denoising rather than compression, and whether multimodal codebook distances should be built into the corruption matrix or noise schedule. A careful technical read should take about 90 to 120 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 应读来校准 diffusion LM 的设计轴：别只比较 loss，token space 和 corruption kernel 要一起做消融。
recommendation.en: Read it to recalibrate diffusion-LM design axes: do not compare only losses; ablate token space and corruption kernels together.

institutions: MBZUAI - Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence

paper.title: I'm Sorry, but I Can't Help with Braille: Revealing Accessibility Failures in State-of-the-Art LLMs
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform strongly on many language tasks, but their capability in structurally constrained, accessibility-critical modalities such as Braille remains unclear. We evaluate state-of-the-art LLMs on bidirectional Korean-Braille translation using a human-annotated dataset. Despite expectations that multilingual, instruction-tuned models can generalize to Braille via text representations, we find consistently poor, unstable outputs and substantial disagreement with human j

summary.core_problem: 评估当前 LLM 在韩语与盲文双向转换上的能力，暴露其在结构受限、无障碍关键文本形式上的失败模式。
summary.importance: 贡献是小型但有辨识度的评测和错误分析。它对预训练研究的价值不在任务本身，而在提示 tokenizer 与低资源结构化文字系统的覆盖缺口，以及 instruction tuning 不能自动弥补这种缺口。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建人工标注的 Korean-Braille translation 数据集，测试多个强 LLM 的零样本和提示表现，并与在同一数据上监督微调的 T5-small 对比。分析重点包括输出不稳定、人类判断不一致、Korean-Braille pattern 对齐弱，以及 Braille-aware tokenization 缺失。
summary.experiments: 评测使用 SacreBLEU、ChrF++、CER、BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR、CIDEr 等指标。摘要称当前 LLM 输出差且不稳定，而 T5-small 经过少量任务监督后在标准指标上获得大幅、稳定提升；未给出具体数据规模和数值。
summary.authors_note: 作者 Abdullah Abdullah 来自 orinu Inc。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates current LLMs on bidirectional Korean-Braille translation and exposes failures on a structurally constrained, accessibility-critical text form.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a small but diagnostic evaluation. Its relevance to pretraining is not the downstream task itself, but the evidence that tokenization and coverage gaps for low-resource structured writing systems are not fixed by instruction tuning alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The author builds a human-annotated Korean-Braille translation dataset, evaluates strong LLMs under zero-shot and prompted settings, and compares them with T5-small fine-tuned on the same data. The analysis focuses on unstable outputs, disagreement with human judgments, weak Korean-Braille alignment, and the absence of Braille-aware tokenization.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses SacreBLEU, ChrF++, CER, BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR, and CIDEr. The abstract reports consistently poor and unstable LLM outputs, while supervised fine-tuning of T5-small yields large and stable gains over prompted LLM baselines; exact dataset size and metric values are not given.
summary_en.authors_note: The author, Abdullah Abdullah, is affiliated with orinu Inc.

recommendation.zh: 任务很窄，但 tokenizer 失败信号清楚；看错误分析即可，不必跟进微调结果。
recommendation.en: The task is narrow, but the tokenizer failure signal is clean; read the error analysis, not the fine-tuning result.

paper.title: The First ChineseBabyLM Challenge: training data-efficient and cognitively plausible language models for Chinese
paper.abstract: This paper describes the first ChineseBabyLM challenge, which will be held in the 2026 NLPCC conference. The challenge calls for researchers to train language models from scratch with 100 million Chinese tokens and evaluates the models on 3 tracks of tasks: NLU, cognitive alignment and Hanzi knowledge. There is no restriction on tokenizer, model architecture and the number of training epochs. Details of the challenge can be found in https://chinese-babylm.github.io/.

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是提出一种新的中文预训练方法，而是给“低数据预算下的中文语言建模”建立一个可比较、可复现、带认知约束的评测框架。核心问题有两个：一是现有 BabyLM 主要围绕英语，不能覆盖中文在分词边界、字词结构、书写系统上的特殊性；二是仅看常规下游任务，无法判断模型是否真的在有限输入下学到了中文特有的语言规律和更接近人类的表征。
summary.importance: 这是一篇 eval 资产型工作，对预训练研究的价值主要在基准设计，而不是方法创新。它的重要性在于把中文数据效率研究从“少量数据上跑几个任务”推进到更系统的设定：固定约 1.02 亿词预算、允许自建同预算语料、同时考察 NLU、汉字知识和脑表征对齐。对 tokenizer、字词粒度建模、数据选择、课程学习、重复训练轮数这些预训练变量，它提供了一个比较合适的实验场。尤其是 Hanzi track 和 cognitive track，把中文特有结构与认知 plausibility 拉进主评测，这一点比单纯复刻英文 BabyLM 更有信息量。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上没有新模型，核心贡献是 challenge 设计。训练规则要求参赛系统从随机初始化开始，在 1 亿级中文 token 预算下预训练。数据来源有两种：使用官方 1.02 亿词语料，或自建但必须满足相同词预算。这样设计的好处是既保留 BabyLM 的数据约束，又允许研究者探索数据筛选、语料构成和 tokenizer 方案。

评测分三条 track，共 14 个任务。第一条是 NLU，包括零样本 minimal-pair 和 CLUE 风格监督迁移任务。零样本部分用 ZhoBLiMP 和隐藏的 XCOMPS-ZH，前者偏句法与语义可接受性，后者偏概念-属性兼容性。第二条是 Hanzi track，直接测模型是否学到汉字的结构和音韵知识，而且如果 tokenizer 无法识别目标字或部件，评测直接记失败。这一点很关键，因为它把 tokenizer 设计从“实现细节”变成了显式研究变量。第三条是 Cognitive Modeling track，用 MulCogBench 的中文 fMRI 数据，拿模型隐状态去预测人类在词级和篇章级理解时的脑响应。

从预训练研究角度，最有意思的是它把三种不同能力放在同一个预算约束下：语言可接受性、汉字知识、神经对齐。这样一来，字符级 tokenizer、BPE、词级切分、混合粒度方案，不再只是看下游分数，而是要面对更细的能力取舍。
summary.experiments:
论文主体更像 task description 而不是方法实验。可确认的关键事实包括：训练预算是约 102 million Chinese words；最终评测共 14 个任务，分为 8 个 NLU、4 个 Hanzi、2 个 Cognitive Modeling 任务；ZhoBLiMP 最终评测包含 118 个 paradigm、每个 300 个样本，共 35,400 对 minimal pairs；隐藏任务 XCOMPS-ZH 包含 14,368 对 minimal pairs；AFQMC 训练/开发集规模为 34,334 / 4,316；OCNLI 为 50,437 / 2,950。正文还说明提供 baseline systems 和初始结果，但给出的全文片段没有包含完整 baseline 表和具体分数，因此不应虚构。

真正值得注意的实验设定细节有两点。第一，minimal-pair 任务对 tokenizer 很敏感，尤其 Hanzi 任务中出现 UNK 会直接失败，这会显著影响子词词表和字符覆盖策略。第二，认知任务不是传统 accuracy，而是用 encoding model 看隐藏状态对 fMRI 响应的预测相关性，这会鼓励研究者关注表示质量，而不只是任务头微调能力。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议很明确。先看 Introduction，理解为什么中文不能直接沿用英文 BabyLM 的任务设计。然后重点看 Evaluation Tasks，尤其是三条 track 的定义和评分方式。对做预训练的人，最该细读的是 Hanzi track 的 tokenizer 约束，以及 cognitive track 如何把 hidden states 接到 encoding model 上。最后再看 baselines 和 challenge rules，判断这个 benchmark 对自己关心的问题是否合适。

如果只是想判断是否值得跟进，30 分钟足够：读任务设计、数据预算规则、隐藏测试设置即可。如果准备拿它做实验，就需要进一步核对官方语料构成、词预算定义、是否按 word 还是 token 计预算、以及不同 tokenizer 在 Hanzi 任务上的覆盖率统计。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper does not introduce a new Chinese pretraining method. Its main goal is to build a controlled benchmark for data-efficient and cognitively grounded Chinese language modeling. The core gap is twofold: BabyLM-style evaluation has been centered on English, and standard downstream tasks alone are not enough to tell whether a model trained on limited Chinese input has learned Chinese-specific linguistic structure or human-like internal representations.
summary_en.importance: This is an evaluation asset rather than a method paper. Its value for pretraining research comes from benchmark design. It creates a more disciplined setting for studying Chinese sample efficiency: a fixed budget of roughly 102 million Chinese words, optional self-compiled corpora under the same budget, and evaluation along NLU, Hanzi knowledge, and neural alignment. That makes it a useful testbed for tokenization, character-vs-word granularity, data selection, curriculum design, and repeated-epoch training under low-resource constraints. The Hanzi and cognitive tracks are the most distinctive parts; they make the benchmark more informative than a direct Chinese copy of English BabyLM.
summary_en.technical_approach:
There is no new model architecture here. The contribution is the challenge design. Systems must be pretrained from random initialization under a BabyLM-style data budget. Participants can either use the official 102-million-word corpus or build their own corpus under the same word budget. This preserves the core low-data constraint while leaving room for research on corpus composition, filtering, and tokenizer design.

Evaluation is organized into three tracks with 14 tasks in total. The NLU track combines zero-shot minimal-pair evaluation and supervised transfer tasks from CLUE. The zero-shot part includes ZhoBLiMP and a hidden XCOMPS-ZH benchmark: the former emphasizes syntactic and semantic acceptability, while the latter targets concept-property compatibility. The Hanzi track directly tests whether models acquire structural and phonological knowledge about Chinese characters. Importantly, if the tokenizer maps the target character or component to UNK, the model automatically fails that item. This turns tokenization coverage into an explicit research variable rather than an implementation detail. The Cognitive Modeling track uses Chinese fMRI benchmarks from MulCogBench, evaluating whether hidden states can predict human neural responses during word-level and discourse-level comprehension.

From a pretraining perspective, the interesting part is that all three dimensions are evaluated under the same data budget. Character tokenizers, BPE, word segmentation, and mixed-granularity schemes are therefore forced to expose their trade-offs more clearly.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper is mainly a task and benchmark description, not a method-heavy experimental study. The key confirmed facts are: the training budget is about 102 million Chinese words; the final evaluation contains 14 tasks grouped into 8 NLU tasks, 4 Hanzi tasks, and 2 cognitive modeling tasks; ZhoBLiMP contains 118 paradigms with 300 examples each, totaling 35,400 minimal pairs; the hidden XCOMPS-ZH task contains 14,368 minimal pairs; AFQMC has 34,334 training and 4,316 development examples; OCNLI has 50,437 training and 2,950 development examples. The text also mentions baseline systems and initial results, but the provided content does not include the full baseline tables or exact scores, so those should not be invented.

Two setup details matter a lot. First, minimal-pair evaluation is highly sensitive to tokenization, especially in the Hanzi track where UNK directly counts as failure. Second, the cognitive track uses correlation-based encoding-model evaluation rather than standard task accuracy, which shifts attention toward representation quality rather than only fine-tuning transfer.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the Introduction to see why Chinese requires a different BabyLM design from English. Then read the Evaluation Tasks section carefully, especially the definitions and scoring protocols of the three tracks. If your focus is pretraining, pay special attention to the tokenizer constraint in the Hanzi track and to how hidden states are mapped into the fMRI encoding model. After that, check the challenge rules and baselines to decide whether the benchmark matches your research questions.

If you only want to assess relevance, 30 minutes is enough: read the task design, the data-budget rules, and the hidden-evaluation setup. If you plan to use the benchmark, you will need to inspect the official corpus composition, the exact definition of the word budget, whether your setup optimizes for words or tokens, and tokenizer coverage statistics for the Hanzi tasks.

recommendation.zh: 读任务定义和数据约束即可；它是中文 tokenizer 与小数据预训练 recipe 的好试验场，不是结论型论文。
recommendation.en: Read the task definition and data constraints; this is a useful testbed for Chinese tokenizer and small-data pretraining recipes, not a conclusion-heavy paper.

paper.title: Echoes Across Vietnam's Highlands, Delta, and Coast: A Multilingual Corpus for Cham, Khmer, and Tay-Nung
paper.abstract: Vietnam's ethnic minority languages are almost absent from the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), and the challenge goes beyond data scarcity: Cham, Khmer, and Tay-Nung differ sharply in script, Vietnamese contact, and standardization, conditions under which standard multilingual adaptation can learn the wrong signals. We introduce CKTN, the first corpus and benchmark for these languages (44,367 documents, 24M subword tokens), spanning continued pretraining, category classification, and

summary.core_problem: 解决越南少数民族语言 Cham、Khmer、Tay-Nung 在多语种 NLP 中几乎缺失、且因文字系统差异和标准化不足导致常规适配方法学到错误信号的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一篇以语料和适配诊断为核心的工作。价值不在于通用 LLM 方法突破，而在于指出低资源多语场景里，tokenizer 碎片化和脚本差异会让常见 continued pretraining 指标产生误导，属于预训练数据与词表设计层面的实证补充。
summary.technical_approach: 作者构建了 CKTN 语料与基准，覆盖 continued pretraining、分类和摘要-文档检索。方法上提出 script-aware adaptation recipe：先做 vocabulary augmentation 缓解分词碎片化，再用 calibrated replaced-token pretraining，避免判别器利用脚本不匹配这类表面线索取巧，从而更关注语义泛化。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 44,367 篇文档、约 24M subword tokens。实验比较现有 multilingual encoders 在这三种语言上的分词碎片化、语言建模损失、词汇重叠检索与跨文档语义泛化表现。结论是：现有多语编码器对这些语言切分严重；单看 LM loss 或 lexical-overlap retrieval 会高估适配效果；脚本感知词表扩展加校准式 replaced-token 预训练能带来更稳健的语义收益。摘要未给出完整数值和主 baseline 名称，强度更像诊断性结果而非大规模 SOTA 报告。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自胡志明市理工大学与 MBZUAI。MBZUAI 在低资源语言与多语 NLP 上有持续投入，但这篇更偏区域语言资源建设与适配分析，不是通用基座团队的主线工作。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper tackles the near absence of Cham, Khmer, and Tay-Nung in NLP, where script variation, Vietnamese contact, and weak standardization make standard multilingual adaptation learn the wrong cues.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a general LLM breakthrough but a data-and-tokenization-centered diagnosis: in low-resource multilingual settings, tokenizer fragmentation and script mismatch can make common continued-pretraining metrics look better while semantic generalization remains poor.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build CKTN, a corpus and benchmark spanning continued pretraining, classification, and summary-document retrieval. Their method is a script-aware adaptation recipe: vocabulary augmentation to reduce fragmentation, plus calibrated replaced-token pretraining so the discriminator cannot exploit trivial script mismatch shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: The dataset contains 44,367 documents and about 24M subword tokens. Experiments compare existing multilingual encoders on fragmentation, LM loss, lexical-overlap retrieval, and cross-document semantic generalization. The key finding is that lower LM loss or better lexical retrieval can still coexist with poor semantic transfer; the proposed script-aware recipe improves robustness. The abstract does not expose full baselines or detailed gains, so this reads more like a careful diagnostic study than a large-scale performance paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology and MBZUAI. MBZUAI has visible work in multilingual and low-resource NLP, though this paper is more of a regional language resource and adaptation study than a frontier foundation-model effort.

recommendation.zh: 做 tokenizer、低资源 continued pretrain 或多语 data mixture 的人可以看；主结论是“LM loss 变好不等于语义适配变好”，其余不必高估。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick read if you work on tokenization or low-resource continued pretraining; the real takeaway is that lower LM loss can be a false proxy for semantic adaptation.

institutions: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology

paper.title: Full Glyph Images Beat Token Embeddings: A Controlled Study for Transformers
paper.abstract: Modern language models generally represent text as sequences of discrete token embeddings, an assumption deeply rooted in current practice but rarely questioned. We challenge this representation, especially for Chinese, by replacing index-based token embeddings entirely with a single rasterized image of the character sequence, processed by a vision encoder composed of a shared ResNet and a shallow Vision Transformer. To isolate the role of input representation, we construct a dual-branch control

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：对中文语言建模来说，离散 token embedding 是否一定是最合适的输入表示。作者把整段中文字符渲染成一张灰度图，用视觉编码器生成位置级表示，再接同一个语言模型 decoder 做 next-token prediction，并与标准 index-based token embedding 做受控比较。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的启发主要在输入表示和 tokenizer 边界。中文字符有稳定的字形结构，离散 ID 会丢掉部件、形近、结构等信息；图像输入可能把这些归纳偏置显式给模型。论文的结论不是直接替代现有 tokenizer，而是提示：在表意文字场景，token embedding 并不是唯一合理的底层接口。更重要的是，它把“字形作为预训练信号”放进了标准 LM 训练框架，而不是停留在 OCR 或下游任务增强。需要注意，vision branch 引入了额外编码器和辅助 loss，因此严格来说不只是“输入模态”差异，结论应理解为一种视觉化输入管线相对标准 embedding 的比较。
summary.technical_approach: 方法采用双分支受控设计。index 分支使用常规字符 ID 和可学习 embedding；vision 分支把完整字符序列渲染成单张二维灰度图，并按非重叠 patch 切分，设定上每个 patch 对应一个字符位置。每个 patch 先经过共享权重的轻量 ResNet 提取局部字形特征，再加入二维位置编码和一维阅读顺序编码，送入浅层 ViT 建模全局上下文。ViT 输出的序列表示维度与 decoder hidden size 对齐，直接替代 token embedding。训练目标仍是每个位置预测下一个 token。为了缓解早期从 LM loss 到视觉输入的长梯度路径，作者给 vision encoder 加了两个辅助任务：patch-level 字符分类，让局部 patch 尽快学会识别字；global classification，让聚合视觉表示直接预测下一个 token。训练还使用二次 curriculum，随 epoch 平滑增加训练样本量。这个设计的关键取舍是：不用 OCR 先把图像转回离散字符，而是让视觉表示成为 LM 的原生输入；代价是输入侧计算更重，且辅助任务会改变优化条件。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕三个问题展开。第一，vision-only 输入在多个 decoder backbone 上都优于 index baseline；作者报告在 GPT-2 backbone 上 peak accuracy 相对提升最高可到 21%。第二，vision 模型优化更快，达到峰值更早；给出的结果是 vision 模型在 epoch 28 停止，而 index baseline 到 epoch 47，说明样本效率和收敛速度都有优势。第三，鲁棒性呈条件性：在中等扰动下，mask ratio ≤ 0.1 时 vision 输入更稳；在较重扰动下，mask ratio ≥ 0.2 时 index 模型由于离散语言先验更强反而占优。论文还做了 patch size、视觉编码器结构、空间扰动，以及 C-Eval 下游评测。由于给出的正文片段没有完整表格数字，除 21% 相对提升、28 vs. 47 epoch 和扰动阈值外，不宜扩展更多具体数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，重点看方法设计和消融。先看 Figure 1 理解双分支控制是否公平；再看 Figure 2 和输入渲染流程，确认 patch 与字符位置的对应关系；然后看辅助 loss 和 curriculum 的章节，因为这些因素会影响“输入表示优劣”的解释。结果部分重点看不同 backbone 的 Acc@1/Acc@5、训练曲线、mask corruption 曲线，以及去掉 ResNet、ViT、辅助任务后的消融。预计 20–30 分钟可以判断方法价值，若关注 tokenizer 和中文预训练表示，可进一步细读实验设置。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether discrete token embeddings are necessarily the right input interface for Chinese language modeling. It replaces character IDs with a rasterized image of the full character sequence, encodes the image into position-level features, and feeds those features into the same LM decoder for next-token prediction.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining is about input representation and the boundary of tokenization. Chinese characters carry visual structure, including radicals, layouts, and shape similarities, which index embeddings discard unless learned indirectly. The work suggests that a glyph-native input pipeline can provide a helpful inductive bias for logographic scripts. It should not be read as a direct replacement for production tokenizers yet. The vision branch adds an encoder and auxiliary losses, so the comparison is not a pure change of input IDs alone. The more robust interpretation is that a visually supervised input stack can outperform a standard character embedding stack under this controlled setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: The study uses a two-branch controlled framework. The index baseline maps character IDs to learned embeddings. The vision model renders the entire sequence into a single grayscale image and partitions it into non-overlapping patches, with each patch aligned to a character position. A shared lightweight ResNet extracts local glyph features from each patch. The model then adds 2D positional embeddings and a 1D reading-order embedding, and passes the sequence through a shallow ViT to produce contextualized visual embeddings. These embeddings are projected to the decoder hidden size and replace token embeddings. The LM objective remains standard next-token prediction. To make optimization easier, the vision branch receives two auxiliary objectives: patch-level character classification for local glyph recognition, and a global classification objective that predicts the next token from an aggregated visual representation. A quadratic curriculum gradually increases the number of training samples across epochs.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports three main findings. First, the vision-only input improves next-token prediction across tested decoder backbones, with up to a 21% relative gain in peak accuracy on a GPT-2 backbone. Second, optimization is faster: the vision model reaches its stopping point at epoch 28, compared with epoch 47 for the index baseline. Third, robustness depends on corruption level. The vision model is more robust under moderate masking, with mask ratio at or below 0.1, while the index model becomes stronger under heavier corruption, with mask ratio at or above 0.2. The paper also includes ablations over architecture, patch size, spatial perturbations, and a C-Eval downstream evaluation. The provided text does not expose full result tables, so the reliable concrete numbers are the 21% relative peak-accuracy gain, 28 versus 47 epochs, and the corruption-ratio thresholds.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper with attention to the control design. Start from Figure 1 to check what is actually held fixed between the two branches. Then inspect the rendering pipeline and Figure 2 to understand how character positions map to image patches. The auxiliary objectives and curriculum are important because they affect how much of the gain comes from representation versus training support. In the results, focus on Acc@1/Acc@5 across backbones, training curves, corruption robustness, and ablations that remove the ResNet, ViT, or auxiliary losses. A 20–30 minute read is enough for the main idea; tokenizer or Chinese pretraining work would justify a closer pass.

recommendation.zh: 值得看实验设计而不是结论标题；若控制真的干净，它会动摇中文 tokenizer/embedding 的默认 prior。
recommendation.en: Read the controlled setup, not the headline; if the controls are clean, it weakens the default prior behind Chinese token embeddings.

paper.title: DeepGaze3.5-VL: Modeling Scanpaths via Autoregressive Token Prediction
paper.abstract: Understanding human visual attention on a scene over time has applications in domains such as interface design and inferring cognitive states. Modeling visual scanpaths has historically relied on specialized architectures with hand-crafted priors. While these architectures can model fixation sequences, their rigid structural biases restrict easy extendability and flexible conditioning. For instance, integrating task-specific instructions or adapting to distinct viewer identities requires custom,

summary.core_problem: 把人类视觉扫视路径预测从专用结构建模问题，改写为视觉语言模型上的离散自回归 token 预测问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是任务形式重构和多模态序列建模。它展示坐标、注视属性、任务指令和个体身份可以统一塞进 token 序列中，用 VLM 的预训练表示做条件建模；对 LLM 预训练的价值在于提醒非语言连续行为也能通过合适离散化进入 AR 框架。
summary.technical_approach: 将注视坐标映射到文本词表或离散 token，把 scanpath 建模为序列预测；利用预训练 VLM 作为条件模型，通过 prompt 加入 viewer identity、visual search 等全局条件，也可在每次注视位置中加入额外属性。方法偏向把已有 VLM 能力迁移到眼动序列，而不是训练新的基座模型。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据集、baseline 和数值结果。实验应比较该 AR token formulation 与传统 scanpath 专用结构，在通用预测、个性化条件和任务条件下的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes human visual scanpath prediction as discrete autoregressive token prediction on top of vision-language models.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a task reformulation for multimodal sequence modeling. It shows that coordinates, fixation attributes, task instructions, and viewer identity can be represented as token sequences and conditioned through a pretrained VLM. The relevance to LLM pretraining is indirect but real: non-linguistic continuous behavior can be brought into an AR modeling interface through discretization.
summary_en.technical_approach: Fixation coordinates are mapped into a text vocabulary or discrete tokens, making scanpath prediction a sequence modeling problem. A pretrained VLM provides visual and language representations, while prompting supplies global conditions such as viewer identity or visual-search goals. The method transfers VLM capabilities rather than proposing a new foundation pretraining recipe.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, datasets, baselines, or numerical improvements. The expected evaluation compares this AR token formulation against specialized scanpath models under generic, personalized, and task-conditioned settings.

recommendation.zh: 作为“连续行为离散成语言 token”的案例可备查；读 formulation 即可，眼动任务本身不值得深挖。
recommendation.en: Useful as a case study in tokenizing continuous behavior into an LM interface; read the formulation, not the eye-tracking details.

paper.title: Breaking Safety at the Token Boundary: How BPE Tokenization Creates Exploitable Gaps in LLM Alignment
paper.abstract: Character-level perturbations bypass safety alignment in modern LLMs despite leaving prompts human-readable. We identify and test a central structural mechanism: BPE tokenization fragments safety-critical words into sub-word pieces, and the three public alignment datasets we surveyed contain no intentionally fragmented inputs. The mechanism is a chain, tested end-to-end on five model families (Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, Mistral-7B). An optimization targeting safety-token f

summary.core_problem: 论文研究一个很具体但影响很大的接口问题：安全对齐通常在干净文本上训练，而 BPE tokenizer 会把轻微字符扰动后的安全敏感词切成不熟悉的子词片段。模型仍能理解这些请求，但拒答机制没有在这类 token 边界形态上学到稳定触发。
summary.importance: 这篇对预训练和对齐接口有直接价值。它把字符级 jailbreak 从经验现象推进到可检验机制：tokenization 改变输入表示，破坏首 token 拒答信号，干扰后层拒答通路，最后转化为一部分有害输出。贡献不在提出更强攻击，而在建立了从 tokenizer、alignment data 覆盖、activation pathway 到行为结果的测量链条。对基座研究的启发是：tokenizer 不是中性预处理；预训练阶段学到的鲁棒理解能力，如果没有在 post-training 数据中覆盖相应形式，会留下理解与拒答之间的不匹配。
summary.technical_approach: 作者围绕 BPE fragmentation 构造了一条端到端机制链。第一步，用 space insertion 作为干净探针，因为插入空格保留原字符，但会强制改变 BPE 切分。攻击不是随机扰动，而是贪心选择能最大降低 safety logit gap 的插入位置。第二步，用首生成位置的 logit gap 测量拒答触发：拒答 token 集合包括 I、Sorry、As、No、Unfortunately、cannot，服从 token 集合包括 Sure、Okay、Here、Step；正 gap 表示拒答倾向。这个指标被明确限定为 first-token refusal trigger，不等同于完整安全行为。第三步，把 gap collapse 与真实输出行为分开统计，避免把触发信号翻转直接当作 jailbreak 成功。第四步，用 activation patching 定位被破坏的拒答信号，发现主要集中在最后约 30% 层。第五步，检查三个公开 alignment datasets，发现没有 intentionally fragmented inputs，并通过 targeted mutation 把问题定位到 safety-critical words，而不是任意字符噪声。最后测试常见防御训练：DPO 网格和 SFT 增强都没有给出干净的选择性修复，SFT 在部分模型上降低 ASR，但同时提高 benign prompt 上的过度拒答。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖五个模型家族：Qwen-3-4B、Qwen-2.5-7B、Gemma-3-4B、Llama-3.1-8B、Mistral-7B，并提供 Qwen-2.5-72B 的跨规模支持。针对 HarmBench 中原本会被拒答的提示，面向 safety-token fragmentation 的优化能在 80–100% 的样本上翻转首 token 拒答触发；其中 48% 的触发翻转进一步产生真实有害输出，各模型范围为 29–65%。gap 与行为之间的 ROC-AUC 为 0.66–0.98，合并后为 0.84，说明 logit gap 是有信息量但不充分的代理指标。Unicode-no-split 控制实验的效果弱 2.2 倍，支持问题来自 BPE 切分变化而不只是视觉扰动。Activation patching 把被扰动的拒答信号定位到最后约 30% 层。数据审计发现三个 alignment datasets 中没有故意碎片化输入。防御部分做了 68 个 DPO 配置，没有一个在不同 seed 下稳定关闭 ASR；Mistral 在 438 对训练样本上的 4-seed 复训仍有 20–37% 的 seed spread。SFT augmentation 在 3/5 个模型家族上降低 ASR，但代价是 benign prompts 上拒答也上升，作者用 Conv-Benign 作为候选诊断来暴露这个副作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 Background 中 BPE 与 logit gap 的定义，因为后续所有实验都依赖这个测量是否可信。然后读 Section 3，重点关注 space insertion 优化、trigger flip 与 harmful behavior 的分离统计，以及 ROC-AUC。Section 4 的 activation patching 是机制证据的核心，需要看具体 patch 的层位置和是否跨模型一致。Section 5 的 alignment data 审计很关键，它解释了为什么预训练能理解扰动文本而对齐不能稳定拒答。Section 6 值得仔细看防御失败模式，尤其是 DPO 的 seed instability 和 SFT 的 over-refusal trade-off。附录 A 的贪心算法和实验设置也建议看，便于判断攻击是否依赖过强的搜索预算。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a narrow but important interface failure: safety alignment is trained mostly on clean text, while BPE tokenization can fragment safety-critical words after small character-level perturbations. The model can still understand the harmful request, but the refusal mechanism no longer fires reliably at the token boundary.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is significant for the tokenizer–pretraining–posttraining interface. The paper does not merely show another character-level jailbreak. It builds a measurable causal chain: BPE fragmentation changes the input representation, collapses the first-token refusal signal, disrupts late-layer refusal pathways, and sometimes turns into harmful behavior. The lesson for foundation-model training is that tokenization is not a neutral preprocessing detail. Pretraining may teach robust comprehension of noisy text, while alignment data may fail to cover the same surface forms, creating a gap between understanding and refusal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors construct an end-to-end mechanism around BPE fragmentation. Space insertion is used as a clean probe because it preserves all original characters while forcing BPE segmentation changes. The perturbation is optimized greedily to reduce a safety logit gap, rather than sampled randomly. The gap is measured at the first generated position: refusal tokens include I, Sorry, As, No, Unfortunately, and cannot, while compliance tokens include Sure, Okay, Here, and Step. A positive gap indicates a refusal tendency. The authors are careful to treat this as a first-token refusal trigger, not as a full behavioral safety metric. They then separate trigger flips from actual harmful generations. Activation patching is used to localize the disrupted signal, which appears mainly in the last roughly 30% of layers. A data audit of three public alignment datasets finds no intentionally fragmented inputs. Targeted mutation further isolates safety-critical words as the main locus of disruption. The defense study evaluates DPO and SFT-style augmentation and shows that neither gives a clean selective fix across model families.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments cover five model families: Qwen-3-4B, Qwen-2.5-7B, Gemma-3-4B, Llama-3.1-8B, and Mistral-7B, with additional cross-scale evidence from Qwen-2.5-72B. On refused HarmBench prompts, an optimization targeting safety-token fragmentation flips the first-token refusal trigger in 80–100% of cases. Among those trigger flips, 48% produce genuinely harmful outputs, with per-model rates from 29% to 65%. The gap-behavior ROC-AUC ranges from 0.66 to 0.98, with a pooled value of 0.84, indicating that the logit gap is informative but not sufficient. A Unicode no-split control is 2.2 times weaker, supporting the claim that the effect is tied to BPE segmentation rather than visual noise alone. Activation patching localizes the disrupted refusal signal to the last about 30% of layers. The alignment-data survey finds zero intentionally fragmented inputs in three datasets. In the defense experiments, no configuration in a 68-cell DPO grid closes ASR in a seed-stable way; a four-seed Mistral retraining run with 438 pairs still shows a 20–37% seed spread. SFT augmentation reduces ASR for 3 of 5 families, but it also increases refusal on benign prompts, which the authors expose with a Conv-Benign diagnostic.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read closely. Start with the definitions of BPE fragmentation and the first-token logit gap, since the credibility of the later results depends on this measurement. Then focus on Section 3: the space-insertion optimization, the separation between trigger flips and harmful behavior, and the ROC-AUC analysis. Section 4 is the main mechanistic section; inspect the activation-patching layer positions and whether the pattern is consistent across model families. Section 5 matters for training data: it explains why robust comprehension from pretraining does not imply robust refusal after alignment. Section 6 is useful for post-training design, especially the DPO seed instability and the SFT over-refusal trade-off. Appendix A is worth checking to understand the greedy search budget and reproducibility details.

recommendation.zh: 会改变“tokenizer 只是工程细节”的 prior；应立刻把 fragmented safety strings 加进安全数据和 tokenizer ablation。
recommendation.en: This changes the prior that tokenization is a harmless implementation detail; add fragmented safety strings to safety data and tokenizer ablations now.

paper.title: MinGram: A Minimalist Unigram Tokenizer with High Compression and Competitive Morphological Alignment
paper.abstract: The Unigram tokenizer uses an elegant representation which makes it straightforward to edit vocabularies, but its training is comparatively heavy and complex. We introduce MinGram (Minimalist Unigram), which keeps the token-list representation but simplifies training using a BPE-derived seed vocabulary, Hard EM on a minimum-token path, and a single flat score-pruning step. This removes the suffix array, the forward-backward pass, and the iterative prune loop, leaving a procedure that requires li

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 Unigram tokenizer 训练复杂、工程接入成本高的问题，同时希望保留 Unigram 词表易编辑的优点，并接近 BPE / minimum-token 方法的压缩率。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在 tokenizer 训练 recipe，而不是模型结构。MinGram 把 Unigram 从一个需要 suffix array、前向后向 EM、迭代剪枝的训练流程，压缩成接近 tokenizer inference 本身的流程。这个方向有实际意义：大模型训练中 tokenizer 一旦选定很难改，Unigram 的 token-list 表示比 BPE merge-list 更适合做词表修补、跨语言合并、低质 token 删除和后续扩展。MinGram 提供了一个工程上更容易落地的折中点：优先优化 token 数压缩，同时用 Unigram score 在等长路径中打破平局，避免 pure least-token 推理带来的形态边界退化。
summary.technical_approach: 方法很直接。第一步不用 Unigram 传统的 substring mining，而是先训练一个 overshoot 的 BPE 词表，大小为目标词表 n 乘以系数 f，再把 BPE 词表和频率作为初始候选集与初始 log probability。第二步用 Hard EM 代替 marginal EM。对每个序列，不再在所有 segmentation lattice 上做前向后向边际统计，而是选一条最优路径：目标近似为最少 token 数，形式是 |s| - δ·sum log p(s_j)。这里 |s| 是主目标，Unigram log probability 只作为等长或近似等长路径的 tie-break。第三步按这条路径累计 token counts，重新估计 token probability。第四步用单次 flat score pruning 代替标准 Unigram 的多轮 loss-estimate pruning。和 PathPiece / pure least-token 类方法相比，MinGram 不只追求最短切分，而是保留一个轻量概率信号来改善形态一致性。和标准 SentencePiece Unigram 相比，它牺牲了一部分概率建模完整性，换来训练实现和词表编辑的简化。
summary.experiments: 论文声称在六种语言上比较压缩率、形态对齐和下游质量。核心结论是：MinGram 保持接近 pure token-count / minimum-token 方法的压缩优势，同时保留了相当一部分 Unigram 的形态对齐能力；相比标准 Unigram，训练流程明显简化；相比 BPE，它继承了 token-list 表示带来的可编辑性。已给出的关键设置包括：BPE seed vocabulary 大小为 ceil(f·n)，Hard EM 迭代 Nem 次，路径搜索目标为最少 token 数加概率 tie-break。当前可见内容没有给出完整表格中的具体数值、下游任务名称和每种语言的绝对差异，因此不应把它解读为已证明 tokenizer 能稳定提升 LM 预训练质量。更稳妥的读法是：它提供了一个低复杂度 tokenizer 训练基线，适合进入更大规模 LM tokenizer ablation。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 Unigram 三个重组件的拆解，以及 Algorithm 1。真正的创新集中在训练目标的取舍：把 token count 作为主目标，把概率分数降级为 tie-break。实验部分建议重点看 compression–morphology Pareto 对比、与 BPE / standard Unigram / least-token inference 的差异，以及是否有下游 LM loss 或 task performance。若要复现实验，优先检查三个超参：BPE overshoot factor f、Hard EM 轮数 Nem、概率 tie-break 权重 δ。值得深挖的问题是：这种 tokenizer 在大规模多语预训练中是否会引入长 token 的欠训练问题，以及 flat pruning 是否会在低资源语言或高形态复杂语言上删掉关键 morpheme。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the training complexity of Unigram tokenizers. It tries to keep the editable token-list representation of Unigram while making training closer to BPE-level simplicity and preserving strong compression.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is tokenizer training for pretraining pipelines. MinGram is not a new LM architecture; it is a simpler way to obtain a Unigram-style vocabulary that can be edited, pruned, merged, or repaired more easily than a BPE merge list. This matters because tokenizer changes are expensive once pretraining starts, and recent work has shown several BPE failure modes around undertrained tokens, morphology, and vocabulary inefficiency. MinGram offers a practical point in the trade-off: prioritize fewer tokens per text, but retain a lightweight probabilistic score to avoid the morphology degradation seen in pure least-token segmentation.
summary_en.technical_approach: MinGram replaces three heavy components of standard Unigram training. It uses an oversized BPE vocabulary as the seed instead of suffix-array substring mining. It replaces marginal EM over the segmentation lattice with Hard EM over a single minimum-token path. For a sequence x, it chooses a segmentation minimizing |s| - δ·sum log p(s_j), so token count is the primary objective and the Unigram score acts as a tie-break. It then counts tokens on the selected paths and re-estimates probabilities. Finally, it uses one flat score-based pruning step instead of iterative loss-estimate pruning. Compared with PathPiece or pure least-token inference, the method keeps a probability signal. Compared with standard SentencePiece Unigram, it gives up some probabilistic completeness for a much simpler implementation.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports comparisons across six languages, focusing on compression, morphological alignment, and downstream quality. The stated result is that MinGram retains the compression behavior of token-count-oriented methods while preserving a substantial part of the morphological alignment usually associated with Unigram. The visible technical setup includes a seed BPE vocabulary of size ceil(f·n), Nem Hard EM iterations, and a minimum-token path objective with a probability tie-break. The available text does not expose the full numerical tables, downstream task details, or per-language effect sizes. A careful reading should therefore treat the contribution as a tokenizer-training simplification and a promising ablation candidate, not as conclusive evidence of improved large-scale LM pretraining loss.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s decomposition of standard Unigram training and on Algorithm 1. The key idea is the objective choice: token count is optimized directly, while the Unigram score is only used to choose among similarly short segmentations. In the experiments, prioritize the compression–morphology trade-off, the comparison with BPE and standard Unigram, and any downstream LM measurements. For reproduction, inspect the overshoot factor f, the number of Hard EM iterations, and the tie-break weight δ. The main open question is whether this training recipe avoids undertrained long tokens and whether single-pass pruning remains robust for low-resource or morphologically rich languages.

recommendation.zh: 值得读方法细节；若内部 tokenizer 仍在 BPE/Unigram 间摇摆，应复现压缩率与 morphology 的 trade-off。
recommendation.en: Read the method details; if your tokenizer choice is still BPE versus Unigram, reproduce its compression–morphology trade-off internally.

paper.title: TokenMinds: Pretrained User Tokens and Embeddings for User Understanding in Large Recommender Systems
paper.abstract: User modeling in industrial recommender systems typically produces dense embeddings, which suffer from representational constraints inherent to fixed-dimensional vectors. An emerging alternative for discrete user representation -- using LLMs to generate text-based user tokens -- captures topical co-occurrences rather than deep sequential behavior dynamics and produces outputs that are difficult to ground to item attributes. Meanwhile, Semantic ID (SID) based item tokenization has proven effectiv

summary.core_problem: 为大规模推荐系统构建离散的用户 token 和稠密用户 embedding，以改善固定维度向量和 LLM 文本化用户描述的表示限制。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工业推荐系统中的离散表示和 tokenization 设计。它不是 LLM 基座预训练论文，但与 Semantic ID、离散用户/物品 token、生成式推荐中的词表设计有交叉，可作为非文本 tokenization 的旁证材料。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 TokenMinds，将 PLUM 从 item retrieval 扩展到 user modeling；用改造自预训练 LLM 的 encoder-decoder 架构，同时生成 SID-based discrete user tokens 和 dense user embeddings。离散 token 强调语义可落地和组合泛化，稠密向量保留连续行为信息，两者作为互补输出。
summary.experiments: 摘要称该系统面向工业规模推荐，比较对象包括固定维度 dense embedding、LLM 生成的文本用户 token、以及只在 item 侧使用 Semantic ID 的生成式推荐做法。提供文本未给出数据规模、模型参数量、线上/离线指标、提升幅度或消融表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper builds discrete user tokens and dense user embeddings for large recommender systems to address limitations of fixed-dimensional vectors and LLM-generated textual user descriptions.
summary_en.importance: This is an industrial recommender representation and tokenization contribution, not an LLM pretraining paper. Its relevance lies in the broader question of how non-text entities can be discretized into semantic IDs for generative modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: TokenMinds extends the PLUM framework from item retrieval to user modeling. An encoder-decoder architecture adapted from pretrained LLMs produces both SID-based discrete user tokens and dense user embeddings. The design aims to combine semantically grounded discrete generalization with continuous behavioral information.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the system as industrial-scale and contrasts it with dense user embeddings, LLM-generated text user tokens, and item-only Semantic ID tokenization. The provided text does not include dataset scale, parameter count, online metrics, offline gains, or ablation results.

recommendation.zh: 可当非文本实体 tokenization 的案例看，别按 LLM 预训练论文读；关键是离散 SID 与稠密表示的接口。
recommendation.en: Useful as a non-text entity tokenization case study, not as an LLM pretraining paper; focus on the SID–dense interface.

paper.title: The African Language Tax: Quantifying the Cost, Latency, and Context Penalty of Tokenizing African Languages in Frontier LLMs
paper.abstract: Commercial large language models bill, scale latency, and budget context per token. Yet tokenizers assign more subword tokens to the same meaning in some languages than in others, so speakers of languages with high token-fertility pay a structural penalty before a model is ever invoked. This penalty is documented for multilingual settings in general, but it has not been measured systematically for African languages at the level of enterprise deployment economics and cognitive context capacity. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的不是多语言能力本身，而是 tokenizer 在不同语言上的结构性不公平，尤其是非洲语言在前沿 LLM 中被切得更碎，导致同样语义需要更多 token，进而带来更高 API 成本、更长延迟和更短有效上下文。论文要解决的核心问题是：这种“tokenization tax”在非洲语言上到底有多大，能否用严格可复现的并行语料测量方法，把它从抽象讨论变成可量化、可比较、可部署决策使用的指标。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的价值主要在 tokenizer 和数据分布层面。第一，它提醒人们 tokenizer 不是中性的预处理，而是直接决定训练和推理经济性的建模组件。对基座模型来说，词表学习若长期偏向英语和高资源网页语料，就会把低资源语言的成本永久固化到系统里。第二，论文把 token fertility、context efficiency、成本和延迟连起来，说明 tokenizer 设计会影响真实可用上下文长度，这对长上下文训练、跨语言对齐、统一词表设计都很关键。第三，它提供了一个比较干净的测量框架：用 parallel corpus 固定语义内容，只看语言—tokenizer 对的编码效率差异。这种方法对后续做 multilingual tokenizer、byte-level / unigram / BPE 对比、词表再分配都很有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是做一个基于并行语料的 tokenizer 审计。作者强调，若直接在非平行语料上比较 token 数，语言差异会和主题、文体、句长混在一起；而并行语料能固定“表达的意义”，使 token 数差异更接近语言形态、书写系统和 tokenizer 词表覆盖本身。为此，论文对 20 种非洲语言和 11 个当前前沿/开放 tokenizer 做统一测量。

指标设计比较扎实。基础计数包括统一 Unicode NFC 归一化后的 word count、token count、character count、UTF-8 byte count。token count 明确排除 special/BOS/EOS，避免固定序列开销污染比较。word segmentation 使用统一的 Unicode UAX-29 规则，而不是为某些语言手工定制，这样牺牲了一部分语言学细腻度，但换来跨语言可比性。核心指标有五个：fertility（tokens per word）、premium（相对英语的 fertility 倍数）、characters per token、bytes per token，以及固定窗口下的 context efficiency。论文还明确采用 corpus-level sum-then-divide，而不是 sentence-level mean-of-ratios，避免短句比例过高时统计不稳定。

在结果解释层，作者没有停留在 tokenizer 内部指标，而是把 fertility 映射到企业部署关心的量：美元和本地货币成本、生成延迟倍数、固定 context window 下可容纳真实内容的比例。这里的思路很实用：如果某语言的 fertility 是英语的 P 倍，那么在相同 API 定价和上下文窗口下，它天然要付出 P 倍左右的 token 成本，并损失相应的“操作记忆”。论文还把汇率波动纳入本地货币成本模型，这一点对非洲市场是现实问题，不只是学术装饰。
summary.experiments:
从全文可确认的实验设计看，作者评估了 20 种非洲语言、11 个 tokenizer，并给出 corpus-level aggregation 与 bootstrap confidence intervals。语言覆盖多种脚本和形态类型，包括拉丁、Geʿez/Ethiopic、Arabic/Ajami、N’Ko 等，这使得结果不只是“低资源语言更差”这么简单，而能分离脚本和形态复杂度的影响。论文还把结果实例化到三个部署场景：银行客服、临床分诊、农业短信咨询，用来展示 fertility 差异如何转化为实际预算、延迟和上下文损耗。

不过，就目前给出的全文片段，具体每种语言和每个 tokenizer 的主结果数值、最高 premium、不同 tokenizer 排名差异等细节没有完整展开，因此没法负责任地复述精确榜单数字。可以确定的是，作者的目标不是证明某一个 tokenizer 最好，而是建立一个可复现基线，并展示非洲语言的 tokenization penalty 明显高于英语，且这种惩罚会同时体现在成本、延迟和 context erosion 上。若阅读全文，最值得抓的应是各语言在不同 tokenizer 下的 premium 分布、脚本族之间的系统差异，以及 context efficiency 在 128k 窗口下的相对损失。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Definitions & Metrics，这两部分决定了论文是否站得住。重点确认三件事：为什么必须用 parallel corpus；为什么 fertility 要用 sum-then-divide 聚合；为什么要同时报告 bytes/token 和 context efficiency，而不只看 tokens/word。接着看主结果表和 leaderboard 式图，关注哪些 tokenizer 在非洲语言上更稳，哪些脚本族受到的惩罚最大。最后看 cost model 和三个 deployment scenario，判断这些数字是否足够接近真实生产约束。

预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线。若想深挖，建议重点看附录里的语料来源、分词实现、异常样本处理和 bootstrap 细节，因为这类测量论文最容易在预处理上引入偏差。另一个值得追问的问题是：如果某些语言在 word segmentation 上天然不适合 UAX-29，那么 fertility 的绝对值会受多大影响；不过即便如此，只要所有语言使用同一规则，相对比较仍然有参考意义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a structural inefficiency in frontier LLM tokenizers: many African languages are segmented into far more tokens than English for the same semantic content. That creates a direct penalty in API cost, latency, and usable context length before model quality even enters the picture. The core problem is to measure this tokenization tax rigorously and reproducibly for African languages, rather than treating it as an anecdotal multilingual fairness issue.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is mainly through tokenizer design and data imbalance. Tokenization is not a neutral preprocessing step; it fixes part of the economics of both training and inference. If the vocabulary is learned mostly from English and other high-resource web languages, low-resource languages inherit a persistent efficiency penalty. The paper is also useful because it connects fertility to context efficiency, which matters for long-context modeling and multilingual system design. Methodologically, the use of parallel corpora gives a cleaner estimate of language–tokenizer efficiency than comparisons on unrelated corpora, so the work provides a solid measurement template for future multilingual tokenizer studies.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The main method is a parallel-corpus audit of tokenizers. The authors argue that non-parallel corpora confound language effects with topic, register, and sentence-length differences. By holding meaning constant across translations, differences in token counts can be attributed more directly to the interaction between language, script, morphology, and tokenizer vocabulary coverage. They evaluate 20 African languages against 11 current frontier and open tokenizers.

The metric design is careful. After Unicode NFC normalization, they compute word count, token count, character count, and UTF-8 byte count under a fixed convention shared across all languages. Token counts exclude BOS/EOS and other special tokens to avoid sequence-overhead artifacts. Word segmentation follows a uniform Unicode UAX-29 rule rather than language-specific heuristics, prioritizing comparability over linguistic tailoring. The paper then derives five metrics: fertility (tokens per word), premium relative to English, characters per token, bytes per token, and context efficiency under a fixed window size. Corpus-level aggregation uses sum-then-divide rather than mean-of-ratios, which is the right choice for stability.

A practical contribution is the translation of fertility into deployment-facing quantities: USD and local-currency costs, latency multipliers, and effective context-window erosion. This makes the tokenizer issue legible to system builders, not just NLP researchers. The inclusion of local-currency volatility in the cost model is also a realistic touch for the target deployment setting.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text content, the study evaluates 20 African languages and 11 tokenizers, with corpus-level aggregation and bootstrap confidence intervals. The language set spans multiple script families and morphological profiles, including Latin, Geʿez/Ethiopic, Arabic/Ajami, and N’Ko, which should make the analysis more informative than a generic multilingual average. The paper also instantiates the cost model in three deployment scenarios: bank customer service, clinical triage, and agricultural SMS assistance.

What is not fully visible in the provided text is the exact leaderboard of premiums, the worst-case language–tokenizer pairs, and the detailed ranking differences across tokenizers. So it would be unsafe to invent precise headline numbers. What is clear is the intended empirical claim: African languages incur a measurable and often substantial tokenization penalty relative to English, and that penalty compounds into higher cost, slower generation, and reduced effective context capacity. When reading the full paper, the most important results to inspect are the premium distributions by language and tokenizer, the script-family effects, and the relative context efficiency at the 128k window size.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, start with the introduction and the metrics section. Those two parts determine whether the measurement setup is credible. Focus on three design choices: why parallel corpora are necessary, why fertility is aggregated with sum-then-divide, and why bytes-per-token and context efficiency are reported alongside tokens-per-word. Then move to the main result tables or leaderboard plots to see which tokenizers are consistently better or worse for African languages and which scripts are most penalized. Finish with the cost model and deployment scenarios to judge whether the analysis maps cleanly to real production constraints.

A 25 to 35 minute read should be enough for the main thread. If reading more carefully, spend time on the appendix sections covering corpus construction, segmentation implementation, preprocessing edge cases, and bootstrap details. Measurement papers often live or die on these choices. One additional question worth checking is how sensitive the absolute fertility values are to the chosen word-segmentation standard for languages that do not align neatly with UAX-29.

recommendation.zh: 建议读结果表；它把 tokenizer fertility 从公平性口号落到成本和上下文预算，可反查内部词表盲点。
recommendation.en: Read the result tables; it turns tokenizer fertility from a fairness slogan into cost and context-budget accounting, useful for auditing internal vocabularies.

paper.title: LangMAP: A Language-Adaptive Approach to Tokenization
paper.abstract: Language-specific tokenizers improve tokenization quality and the downstream performance of models on those languages. However, using such a tokenizer comes at a cost: either a new model must be trained from scratch, or the vocabulary of an existing pretrained model must be adapted. We propose Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori (LangMAP) Tokenization, a tokenization scheme that extends the UnigramLM algorithm to the multilingual setting, producing language-specific tokenization from a single

summary.core_problem: 现有生产级多语言分词器普遍以英语统计为核心优化，导致非英语语言（尤其是黏着语、非拉丁脚本）分词过碎、词素边界对齐差，拉低下游性能、推高推理成本；而现有语言专属分词适配方案要么需要从头训练模型，要么需要修改预训练模型词表并适配参数，算力开销极高。很多时候分词质量差并非词表缺少对应词素，而是全局分词规则（如BPE中高优先级的th合并）会跨词素切分，现有方案存在不必要的开销。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的核心价值是：在不改动词表、不重新预训练/适配模型参数的前提下，仅通过调整分词的概率建模逻辑就能优化多语言/代码的分词质量，大幅降低多语言基座预训练的词表设计成本，以及英文主导预训练模型向小语种适配的迁移成本。UnigramLM框架的语言条件化扩展也为多语言分词的统一建模提供了新思路，避免了为不同语言维护独立分词器/词表的复杂度。
summary.technical_approach: 基于UnigramLM算法扩展出LangMAP（语言自适应最大后验分词），核心设计保留共享词表不变：1）训练阶段：在同一固定词表下，为每种语言单独学习一套token概率分布（替代原生UnigramLM的全局单一分布），仅需要带语言标签的语料，不需要修改词表或模型参数；2）推理阶段：对输入字符串，分别计算每种语言专属分布下的最大后验（MAP）分词结果，选择全局似然最高的结果输出，不需要输入显式语言标签。
summary.experiments: 针对9种自然语言+9种编程语言改造多个开源分词器，结果：1）自然语言：对基座词表脚本覆盖度高的语言，词素边界对齐准确率显著提升；对脚本覆盖度差的语言，提升接近0；2）代码：所有测试语言的AST叶子节点边界对齐准确率一致提升；3）微调实验（仅在分词变化最大的语言上测试）：LangMAP训练的模型在目标语言的MultiBLiMP（语法可接受性任务）上准确率高于同配置基线，黏着语提升最明显；常识推理（Global-PIQA）、阅读理解（Belebele）上无一致差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计20-25分钟。重点关注：引言中德语复合词Rathaus的分词例子（直观理解全局分词规则的核心缺陷）；分词方法章节中LangMAP与原生UnigramLM的公式对比（掌握共享词表下语言专属分布的设计逻辑）；实验部分的边界对齐结果与分语言微调表现（明确方法的适用边界：仅对词表脚本覆盖充分的语言有效）。不需要深抠EM优化的数学细节。

summary_en.core_problem: Most production multilingual tokenizers are optimized for English statistics, causing over-segmentation and poor morpheme boundary alignment for non-English languages (especially agglutinative languages and non-Latin scripts), which degrades downstream performance and inflates inference costs. Existing language-specific tokenization adaptation solutions require either full model retraining or vocabulary modification with parameter adaptation, incurring prohibitive compute overhead. Critically, poor segmentation often stems not from missing vocabulary coverage, but from global tokenization rules (e.g., high-priority 'th' merge in BPE) that cut across morpheme boundaries, making existing adaptation schemes unnecessarily costly.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, LangMAP demonstrates that tokenization quality for non-English languages and code can be improved via probability modeling adjustments alone, with no vocabulary changes, retraining, or parameter adaptation required. This sharply reduces the cost of vocabulary design for multilingual base models, as well as the migration cost of adapting English-centric pretrained checkpoints to low-resource languages. The language-conditional extension of the UnigramLM framework also provides a unified modeling path for multilingual tokenization, eliminating the complexity of maintaining independent tokenizers or vocabularies per language.
summary_en.technical_approach: LangMAP (Language-adaptive Maximum a Posteriori tokenization) extends the vanilla UnigramLM algorithm with two key adjustments while keeping the vocabulary fully fixed: 1) Training stage: Instead of learning a single global token probability distribution, it learns language-specific distributions over the shared fixed vocabulary, requiring only language-labeled corpus and no vocabulary or model parameter changes. 2) Inference stage: For an input string, it computes the MAP segmentation under each language-specific distribution, then selects the segmentation with the highest overall likelihood as output, with no explicit input language label required.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on 9 natural languages and 9 programming languages across multiple open-source tokenizers. Results: 1) Natural language: Significant gains in morpheme boundary alignment for languages with scripts well-covered by the base vocabulary; near-zero gains for poorly covered scripts. 2) Code: Consistent improvements in AST leaf boundary alignment across all tested programming languages. 3) Fine-tuning experiments (only on languages with the largest segmentation changes): Models trained with LangMAP achieve higher target-language MultiBLiMP (grammatical acceptability) accuracy than identically configured baselines, with the largest gains on agglutinative languages; no consistent differences are observed on commonsense reasoning (Global-PIQA) or reading comprehension (Belebele).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level read, 20-25 minutes estimated. Focus on: The German compound word 'Rathaus' example in the Introduction (intuitive illustration of global tokenization rule flaws); formula comparison between LangMAP and vanilla UnigramLM in the Tokenization section (core design of language-specific distributions over a shared vocabulary); boundary alignment results and per-language fine-tuning performance in the experiments section (to clarify the method's applicability boundary: effective only for languages with well-covered scripts). No need to dive into mathematical details of EM optimization.

recommendation.zh: 一种优雅的无需修改词表的多语言分词适配方案，对多语言预训练和词表设计有启发，值得关注其 UnigramLM 扩展机制。
recommendation.en: An elegant multilingual tokenization adaptation scheme without modifying the vocabulary, inspiring for multilingual pretraining and vocabulary design; worth noting its UnigramLM extension mechanism.

paper.title: Morpheus: A Morphology-Aware Neural Tokenizer and Word Embedder for Turkish
paper.abstract: Turkish is agglutinative: meaning is carried by morphemes, yet the subword tokenizers that drive modern language models split words by corpus statistics, fragmenting semantically loaded suffixes and -- in the case of WordPiece and rule-based analyzers -- failing to decode their output back to the original text. This paper presents \textbf{Morpheus}, a neural morpheme-boundary model for Turkish that is at once a lossless, morphology-aware tokenizer and a word-embedding producer. A differentiable

summary.core_problem: 为土耳其语这类黏着语设计可逆、形态感知的 neural tokenizer，避免统计子词切分破坏语素边界。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 tokenizer 方法创新，偏语言特定。它触及一个预训练研究中的老问题：BPE/WordPiece 对高形态复杂语言并不总是合适，尤其是生成模型要求 tokenizer 可逆时。对通用 LLM 的价值主要在 tokenizer inductive bias，而不是规模化训练结果。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Morpheus，一个预测字符级语素边界的 neural tokenizer，同时输出结构化 word embedding。训练时使用可微 Poisson-binomial dynamic program，把每个字符位置的边界概率转成 soft morpheme memberships；推理时给出精确切分。方法不做字符串 normalization，并保证 decode(encode(w)) = w，因此满足生成模型的可逆性要求。
